jobs.title: Freelance Project Coordinator - Administrative
jobs.description:
**Summary**

**About the Project:**  
Supercharged is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Freelance Project Coordinator to support our growing Roadshow team. This role will provide critical coordination, project administration, data management, and workflow support across multiple concurrent clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and deliverables.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast\-moving, project\-based environment and is exceptionally comfortable keeping information organized, following up on open items, maintaining accurate project records, and making sure deadlines and deliverables stay on track.

**This is a hands\-on coordination role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and visibility to complex projects.**

**What You'll Do:**

* Support maintenance of our project\-management foundation across Egnyte, Airtable, Teamwork, Slack, Iconik, and CoreCRM, ensuring the Roadshow team can consistently locate accurate information, resources, and deliverables.
* Provide additional bandwidth as the Roadshow grows, helping the team manage multiple clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and reporting requirements without sacrificing organization, accuracy, or delivery quality.
* Prepare and maintain reporting and activation records by auditing metadata, hyperlinks, statuses, task comments, cluster records, stop records, and activation records against established requirements.
* Reinforce standardized workflows and delivery timelines by facilitating repeatable processes, applying due dates, preparing resources, and maintaining weekly update cadences across clusters and activations.
* Increase accountability and visibility by proactively identifying missing deliverables, overdue tasks, incomplete metadata, unresolved Slack threads, and other gaps before they create downstream delays.
* Relieve Roadshow leadership and project staff of high\-volume administrative and data\-management work so they can focus on production, stakeholder management, strategy, and core Roadshow execution.
* Coordinate information across platforms and workstreams, ensuring corresponding records, folders, reports, tasks, contacts, and creative assets are accurately linked and reflect consistent project information.
* Conduct regular quality\-control checks to identify inconsistencies, missing information, or outdated records.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and project owners to obtain missing information and keep workstreams moving.
* Maintain a high level of organization and accuracy across a fast\-changing portfolio of projects.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, marketing operations, agency operations, event/experiential production, or a similar role.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, clients, activations, or stakeholders simultaneously.
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills with a strong attention to detail.
* Ability to proactively identify gaps and follow through until issues are resolved.
* Comfortable working across multiple project\-management, collaboration, CRM, and file\-management platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned workflows.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
* Strong follow\-up skills and a high level of accountability.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience with tools such as Airtable, Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, ClickUp, Slack, or similar platforms is highly valued.
* Experience in events, experiential marketing, creative agencies, sports, entertainment, media, lifestyle, or marketing\*\* is strongly preferred.

**Location \& Time Zone:**

* **Candidates must be located in California and work within the Pacific Time Zone** (PST/PDT).
* **Please do not apply if you are not currently located in California** or are unable to consistently work Pacific Time hours.

**NOTE:**

* If selected for this role the client will run a background check.
* Please be prepared to be responsive to interview request within 24 hours.

**Success in This Role:**

Success in this role means the Roadshow team can rely on you to keep project information accurate, organized, connected, and current; identify issues before they become problems; maintain momentum across deadlines and deliverables; and provide the administrative and coordination support that allows the broader team to focus on executing exceptional Roadshow experiences.

If you are someone who naturally creates order, loves a well\-maintained project tracker, follows up relentlessly, and can keep many moving pieces organized at once, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

Please provide example of relevant experience and how it relates to this role OR where on your resume can these details be seen?

jobs.title: Program Coordinator II, Community Based Research Initiative (Community Engagement & Research Coordination)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**



Under the general supervision of the Executive Director and Program Principal Investigator, the INSPIRE Programs Coordinator will manage the day\-to\-day operations of CDU’s growing portfolio of INSPIRE community\-based research programs—INSPIRE Faith, INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA. The Coordinator serves as the primary operational point of contact across these programs, combining research\-program coordination, community relationship\-building, and oversight of the digital engagement and data\-capture platforms (in partnership with the technology team) that enable the programs to operate at scale. The role blends hands\-on, place\-based community partnership (primarily through INSPIRE Faith) with the coordination of predominantly online, largely automated statewide, and national programs. A central purpose of the role is to strengthen community trust in research and to broaden the participation of Black/African American/Hispanic communities and other communities of color in clinical research and trials, ensuring that community voice and priorities shape how the work is designed and carried out.



About the Center:



The Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (CDU), a partner in the UCLA Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) alongside UCLA and Cedars\-Sinai, is building a community\-centered clinical research enterprise through its Clinical and Translational Research Center (CTRC) in South Los Angeles. The INSPIRE programs are a family of community\-based research initiatives advancing health and brain health across diverse populations. INSPIRE Faith is a deep, place\-based partnership with faith institutions requiring regular in\-person engagement with community partners; INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA are digitally delivered, largely automated programs conducted primarily online, with select live sessions led by physicians and study staff. Together they build on CDU’s longstanding legacy of community engagement and health\-equity research.

  



This work advances a national commitment to health equity: expanding access to healthcare in underserved communities, building lasting trust between communities of color and the healthcare system, and increasing the participation of Black/African American communities and other communities of color in research and clinical trials. As a historically Black graduate institution, CDU pursues these goals in partnership with peer institutions and community organizations, treating community relationships not as a means of recruitment but as the foundation of research that is shaped by, accountable to, and beneficial for the communities it serves. The INSPIRE Programs Coordinator is central to this mission, serving as the trusted community bridge that connects faith and community partners to research and trial opportunities and helps ensure that the science reflects the priorities of the community.


**Essential Duties**


* Manage the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of the INSPIRE research programs (Faith, CA, and USA), ensuring each program runs smoothly, on schedule, and in alignment with study protocols and the Center’s mission
* Coordinate in\-person activities for INSPIRE Faith—anticipated at approximately two days per week of on\-site engagement with community partners—and support the logistics of live sessions conducted by physicians and study staff across all programs, including scheduling, participant coordination, and event execution.
* Coordinate and support program staff, students, and volunteers across the INSPIRE programs, including onboarding, task coordination, and training
* Support participant recruitment, retention, and outreach across programs, including coordinating culturally appropriate promotional and educational materials (in collaboration with the communications team)
* Attend community meetings, faith\-partner gatherings, health events, and program activities as needed to represent the INSPIRE programs and CDU
* Oversee the online engagement platform, participant communications, scheduled calls, and data\-capture elements for the digitally delivered programs (INSPIRE CA, and USA), coordinating closely with the technology team to ensure the platforms function reliably and participant data is captured accurately and securely.
* Monitor program metrics, participant engagement, and feedback to assess effectiveness, support quality improvement, and inform recommendations to program leadership
* Establish and support Faith Community Advisory Boards across Los Angeles, coordinating the formation of one board in 2026 and several additional boards by 2028\. Each board is a governance body of no more than 11 faith leaders drawn from partnering faith institutions, guiding program direction, protocol input, and community voice at the faith\-partner level.
	+ The Coordinator organizes board recruitment, scheduling, meeting logistics, and ongoing stewardship.
* Recruit, onboard, and support Community Navigators from partnering faith institutions, growing the Navigator corps to 50 by the end of 2026 and more than 500 by the end of 2028\. Navigators are community members who support the conduct of the studies from the faith\-community side, including participant recruitment, guidance in navigating different community and clinical spaces, and support at program events.
	+ Navigators are distinct from advisory board members and are not study participants themselves.
* Organize and help lead faith\-based health festivals, coordinating planning, faith\-partner engagement, logistics, staffing, and execution to advance community health and program visibility across partnering faith institutions.
* Build trusted partnerships with community and faith\-based organizations, serving as the primary liaison and fostering ongoing engagement across INSPIRE programs.

Job Description

**Legal Name of Agency:** Central City Neighborhood Partners

**Position Title:** Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator

**Reports to:** 

Financial Empowerment Manager

**Hours and Benefits:** This is a full\-time, on\-site position offering an hourly rate of $19\-$22, based on experience, with an expected commitment of 40 hours per week. The role includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.

**ORGANIZATIONAL/PROGRAM BACKGROUND:**

Central City Neighborhood Partners (CCNP) was established in 1994 and incorporated as a formal non\-profit collaborative in 2000 to address the socio\-economic conditions impacting low\-income families living in the City of Los Angeles, with a focus on Westlake and surrounding communities. and expanding to Koreatown in 2024\. With the mission of catalyzing partnerships to systemically address the multiple challenges facing low\-income families, CCNP works with its partners to help families create pathways to financial security and economic opportunity through our FamilySource Center (FSC) program, financial asset\-building programs and other signature programs.

**Position Overview:**

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing strategic outreach initiatives to connect with and serve individuals and communities impacted by specific events or conditions such as the fires. This role requires building strong relationships with community stakeholders and partners to ensure the effective delivery of information and resources. The person is responsible for active recruitment of individuals to CCNP programs, specifically recruiting eligible individuals to participate in financial and career development.

**Outreach Coordinator** will perform a broad range of duties spanning the full employment cycle, including, but not limited to providing support and/or monitoring of the following

* Warmly welcome clients and provide information and referrals based on client needs;
* Anticipate, meet and exceed client needs by maintaining a current working knowledge of all programs, activities and procedures;
* Develop and implement strategic outreach plans tailored to the needs of impacted populations.
* Lead workshops and trainings to the general public and offer 1\-1 navigation support
* Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, organizations, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Create and distribute outreach materials such as brochures, flyers, and newsletters, and graphics that can be ready to post on social media
* Work with internal teams to align outreach strategies with overall organizational goals and respond to public inquiries.
* Attend community outreach events, job fairs, and other events to promote the financial and career coaching opportunities.
* Assist in the preparation of all outreach material for distribution in the community
* Additional tasks, projects and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor and executive leadership.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Savvy and energetic with ability to outreach, connect and engage the community in activities;
* Ability to instruct and present ideas, rules and activities in a clear and comprehensive manner;
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills required, ability to multi\-task, and the ability to fill\-in for co\-workers as the work schedule requires;
* Must be able to cultivate teamwork, exercise good judgment and be comfortable working with partners, staff and clients of diverse backgrounds and circumstances;
* Must be a self\-starter, have initiative, excellent follow\-through skills and problem\-solving capacity;
* Commitment to the mission and goals of CCNP.
* Proven experience in outreach, community engagement, public relations, or a related field.
* Familiarity with the Westlake and surrounding communities
* The ability to read, write and speak in English and Spanish is required, given that many of the targeted families are monolingual in Spanish. Cultural sensitivity is required.
* Operational knowledge of the Internet and web\-related technologies; Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint); Windows Operating System.
* Ability to manage databases and reporting systems in order to produce a variety of written reports.

**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Any combination equivalent to: High School Diploma/GED and two years of general office experience; related coursework and certifications encouraged.

**Other Requirements**

* Successfully pass all post offer, pre\-employment screening requirements, including criminal background check, and provide proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
* TB Certificate
* Full COVID\-19 Vaccination
* Must have a valid California Driver’s License, proof of liability insurance, and access to a reliable automobile are required because this position involves traveling to multiple locations to conduct outreach and perform job\-related duties.

**COVID\-19 Vaccine required for all employees**Central City Neighborhood Partners has implemented a mandatory vaccination policy effective October 1, 2021 requiring COVID\-19 vaccinations for all employees (with approved religious and medical accommodations). At present, an individual is deemed “fully vaccinated” when that person has received, either the single\-dose COVID\-19 vaccine Pfizer or Moderna. As a condition of employment, employees must submit official COVID\-19 vaccine documentation.

**Physical Requirements**

* To perform this job the individual must be able to carry out all essential functions satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.
* Approximately 50% of time is spent sitting, while frequently required to walk, stand and bend.
* Must be able to speak and hear well.
* Good vision is imperative.
*

**ABOUT EARTH COMPOUNDING PHARMACY**

Our mission is to help people achieve optimal wellness through personalized, research\-based compounded medications made just for them. We are a fast\-growing compounding pharmacy in California, and we are looking for pharmacy technicians who thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL FIND HERE**

**Fast Growth \& Opportunity**  
Join a rapidly expanding pharmacy where high performers are recognized, challenged, and given opportunities to grow.

**Meaningful Work**  
Every prescription we prepare is customized to meet a patient's unique needs. Your attention to detail directly impacts patient outcomes.

**High Standards \& Strong Team Culture**  
We believe in accountability, professionalism, and teamwork. We work hard, support one another, and take pride in delivering an exceptional experience to our patients and providers.

**About the Role**

As a **Patient Care and Sales Coordinator**  at **Earth Compounding Pharmacy**, you are the first voice our patients hear and a key part of how we deliver an exceptional experience from the first call to the final shipment. You will manage inbound and outbound patient communication, process prescriptions accurately, and proactively offer patients the options that best serve their health and their budget, including multi\-month supply options where product expiration allows.

If you take pride in doing things right the first time, thrive on building patient relationships, and want to grow within a company that rewards results, we want to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect**

✅ **Intensive Training**  
No experience working in the pharmacy? We will train you — but only if you are committed to learning and delivering results. You’ll work side\-by\-side with experienced professionals who expect you to keep up, ask questions, and take ownership of your growth.

✅ **High Standards, Real Impact**  
We are trusted to prepare custom medications that impact patients’ health every single day. Accuracy and attention to detail are not optional — they are the baseline.

✅ **A Team That Delivers**  
You’ll be part of a results\-driven group where everyone pulls their weight. We value **accountability**, **dependability**, and **competence** — and we expect the same from every team member.

**Requirements**

* Proven reliability and punctuality
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under time pressure
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with a high\-performance team
* Commitment to learning and improving daily

If you are **ambitious**, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and are ready to meet high expectations, apply now to join a team that rewards hard work and results.

**What You Will Do**

* Answer and make phone calls with professionalism, urgency, and genuine care for the patient
* Process prescriptions accurately, verifying addresses, quantities, expiration dates, and supply options before every order
* Proactively offer specials and multi\-month supply options to patients when product expiration allows
* Communicate clearly and consistently with patients, providers, and teammates
* Take ownership of errors, correct them immediately, and apply the lesson going forward
* Support daily pharmacy operations with attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong communication skills and a willingness to pick up the phone and engage; this role requires high phone volume
* Exceptional attention to detail; mistakes in a pharmacy setting have real consequences for patients

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator / Client Experience Advocate - Plastic Surgery
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**
Adoreal works with a small number of leading aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, giving them the technology, operational support, and talent they need as they grow. We are hiring on behalf of one of those partners, a plastic surgery practice in Santa Monica, for a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) / Client Experience Advocate (CEA).


Adoreal partners with a select group of top\-tier aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, providing the technology, operational support, and talent that help them deliver an exceptional patient experience while they scale. We are recruiting on behalf of one of our partner practices, a high\-end, luxury plastic surgery practice based in California.


**About The Role**
This is a patient care coordination and client experience role. You own the patient relationship from the first phone call through consultation, treatment, and everything after. It is not a front desk job. A separate front\-office team handles reception, check\-in, and the day\-to\-day running of the office, and you will work alongside them.


What matters most here is the conversation itself. You find out what a patient actually wants, talk openly about options and pricing, and help them reach a decision they feel settled about, whether that decision is yes or no. Do that well and patients come back for years and send their friends. It suits someone who is at their best one\-on\-one and who follows up when they said they would.


Key Responsibilities**Inquiry \& Consultation Intake**

* Handle incoming inquiries by phone, email, and social. The first call sets the tone, so ask real questions and find out what the patient is actually after.
* Turn those inquiries into booked consultations, and send patients in prepared so they are not hearing everything for the first time in the room.
* Keep notes current in the practice EMR and CRM. A patient history, goals, and hesitations should not have to be rediscovered at the next visit.

**Patient Care Coordination**

* Be the person patients call, from consultation through surgery, recovery, and follow\-up.
* Walk patients through pre\-op and post\-op instructions and answer the questions they are nervous to ask.
* Coordinate with the surgeon and other treatment providers, and clinical staff, so nothing falls between them.
* Follow up to confirm appointments and check on recovery, before a patient has to chase you.

**Client Experience \& Practice Growth (CEA)**

* Present treatment plans, pricing, and financing clearly, so patients can decide with the full picture in front of them.
* Run the consultation conversation with structure. Understand the goal, address hesitations head on and help every patient throughout their decision\-making process.
* Follow up on a real schedule with patients who need time to think. Consultative, never pushy, but nobody should go quiet in your pipeline because you forgot about them.
* Keep track of your own pipeline of prospective patients, from first inquiry to booking, in the practice CRM.
* Help them navigate financing options such as CareCredit and Cherry.
* Help with reputation management by asking happy patients for reviews and handling any service complaint quickly.
* Protect patient privacy and hold the standard of discretion a practice like this depends on.

  

**Requirements**  

* You live in or near Santa Monica. This role is on\-site.
* Polished, presentable, and professional in appearance and demeanor at all times.
* Organized and diligent, and comfortable holding several patients, schedules, and priorities in your head at once.
* Comfortable talking about value. Pricing, treatment plans, and financing come up constantly, and how you handle those conversations shapes whether patients go ahead.
* You see what needs doing and do it, rather than waiting to be told.
* Genuinely at ease in a clinical setting and around patients.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with a warm, client\-service instinct.
* Prior experience as a patient coordinator, treatment coordinator, or client experience advocate in plastic surgery, dermatology, a medspa, or a similar aesthetics setting.
* Formal consultative sales training in aesthetics or elective medicine is a strong plus, as is a track record of owning the consult\-to\-booking process.
* Familiarity with aesthetics EMR, CRM, and scheduling software helps, but we can teach the software.

  

**Benefits** **Adoreal is helping our partner plastic surgery practice fill a position internally. This position is not with Adoreal directly.**

**We provide the operational, marketing, and growth infrastructure that empowers surgeons to focus on what they do best: delivering exceptional patient care and outcomes.**

 **By combining innovative business strategies with world\-class clinical talent, Adoreal enables clinics and surgeons to thrive in today’s competitive elective medicine landscape.**

jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sift's Business Development Representatives are the front line of our enterprise sales team. You'll own a portfolio of named accounts across aerospace, defense, and industrial engineering, building relationships with the teams designing rockets, satellites, autonomous systems, and other mission\-critical hardware.


This isn't mindless outbound. Success comes from curiosity, research, and good judgment. You'll learn how complex engineering organizations buy software, identify the right technical and executive stakeholders, and secure conversations through thoughtful, personalized outreach. You'll partner closely with an Account Executive to develop account strategy, travel to industry events and customer sites, and use AI\-assisted tooling to research accounts and scale high\-quality outreach.


As one of our early GTM hires, you'll work closely with sales leadership, gain exposure to full enterprise deal cycles, and build the technical and commercial foundation to grow into an Account Executive, sales leadership, or other GTM roles as you succeed.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own a portfolio of named accounts and drive the outreach strategy for each, from first touch to qualified meeting
* Map account org structures: identify decision\-makers, champions, and technical stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and program leadership
* Prioritize accounts using signals like funding, new leadership, program announcements, and industry news
* Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next
* Run personalized, multi\-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn) tailored to the technical buyer, not generic sequences
* Partner closely with your assigned AE: align on account strategy, keep pipeline visibility current, and ensure a clean handoff once a meeting is booked (join the first call as needed, but the AE owns prep)
* Keep CRM and account records current and accurate
* Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 1\-4 years in a customer\-facing, high\-performance environment (B2B sales development, consulting, program or capture support, or similar)
* Strong written communication; able to write outreach that reads as specific and researched, not templated
* Comfortable owning a portfolio and prioritizing without heavy oversight
* Highly self\-motivated, hardworking, and driven, with a track record of finding creative approaches when the obvious path doesn't work
* Genuine curiosity about hard tech, aerospace, defense, or industrial engineering
* Willing to travel for events and customer visits

jobs.title: VA Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================



Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. As AAG's government sales team grows, there is a defined path forward — into senior territory roles, national account management, and eventually broader federal healthcare opportunities beyond the VA.


**About American Armor Gloves**
===============================



American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company has built its business on advanced manufacturing, operational discipline, and a commitment to quality — supplying healthcare professionals, first responders, and other essential workers who depend on consistent, reliable protection.


**We are actively interviewing for this role now — apply today to be considered.**

You'll run the client journey with introductory lessons, manage front desk operations, support our sales process, and make sure every person who walks through our doors feels seen, welcomed, and excited to start their dance journey.

As US Print\-on\-Demand Key Account Manager, you will lead the growth and development of Stanley/Stella's Print\-on\-Demand business across the United States.  

  

Acting as the primary commercial owner of the channel, you will build and strengthen relationships with official dealers, strategic partners and key accounts while identifying new opportunities to accelerate growth.  

Combining business development, account management and strategic planning, you will play a key role in expanding Stanley/Stella's presence within the US Print\-on\-Demand ecosystem and delivering a premium experience to our partners.  

  

Working closely with our European Print\-on\-Demand team and cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Excellence, you will help shape the future of one of Stanley/Stella's key growth channels.#### **Your role and impact**

**Channel \& Account Development**
----------------------------------

* Define and execute the US Print\-on\-Demand commercial strategy in line with Stanley/Stella's growth ambitions and brand positioning
* Identify, recruit and develop new Print\-on\-Demand partners, official dealers and strategic accounts across the region
* Build and execute account plans that support customer growth, strengthen partnerships and unlock new business opportunities
* Lead regular business reviews focused on sales performance, profitability, service levels and growth initiatives
* Own sales and profitability targets and proactively implement actions to drive performance
**US \& European Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Partner closely with the European Print\-on\-Demand team to align account strategies, share market insights and ensure consistency across international partnerships
* Act as the voice of the US market, bringing customer feedback, trends and opportunities into global discussions
* Adapt global initiatives and strategic programs to maximize their impact in the US market
**Market Presence \& Relationship Building**
--------------------------------------------

* Develop a strong network within the Print\-on\-Demand, decoration and apparel ecosystem
* Establish trusted relationships with key stakeholders across customers, partners and industry influencers
* Represent Stanley/Stella at trade shows, industry events, customer meetings and networking opportunities
* Strengthen brand visibility and reinforce Stanley/Stella's position as a preferred partner within the market
**Sales Planning, CRM \& Business Performance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and account information within the CRM environment
* Deliver reliable sales forecasts and provide clear insights on performance drivers, risks and opportunities
* Leverage sales data, market intelligence and business insights to prioritize opportunities and optimize account performance
* Develop and monitor annual sales plans for the channel, strategic accounts and dealer network
**Cross\-Functional Execution**
-------------------------------

* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Excellence teams to deliver outstanding customer experiences
* Ensure commercial commitments are aligned with inventory availability, operational capabilities and profitability objectives
* Support the development of customer\-facing initiatives, co\-branded programs and growth opportunities that strengthen demand and engagement
#### **About you**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development or Key Account Management within Print\-on\-Demand, promotional products, wholesale apparel or a related industry
* Proven track record of developing strategic partnerships, recruiting channel partners and growing key accounts
* Experience managing account plans, sales pipelines and revenue targets
* Existing network within the Print\-on\-Demand, apparel decoration or promotional products ecosystem is a strong advantage
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify growth opportunities
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship\-building skills
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a high level of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-growing and evolving business environment
* Experience collaborating with international and cross\-functional teams is a plus
* Willingness to travel extensively across the US (minimum 50%) and occasionally internationally
#### **About us**


Founded in 2012, Stanley/Stella has become Europe’s leading brand for premium and sustainable blank apparel. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to redefine how responsible fashion is made, distributed and experienced.


We combine contemporary design with uncompromising quality and a deeply embedded commitment to sustainability. Every choice, from the fabrics we select to the long\-term partnerships we build, reflects our belief that doing better is not optional; it is essential.


At Stanley/Stella, excellence is not a slogan. It is our way of working. We operate with transparency, respect and an entrepreneurial spirit that empowers every team member to make an impact. Together we are shaping a more conscious and inspiring future for our industry and for everyone who wears our products.


Join a company that leads by example, grows with purpose and creates change that lasts.

jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Curator\-in\-Charge, the Curatorial Project Coordinator provides support to the curatorial staff for the day\-to\-day operation of the Prints and Drawings Department (Achenbach Foundation for Graphic Arts). This role assists curatorial staff in all areas, including collections records, bibliographic and biographical records and files, research for exhibitions and publications, loans, and general curatorial inquiries.  

This is a 1\-year fixed\-term position, November 2026 \- November 2027\. The application deadline is Friday, September 25, 2026, 9 PM PST.  

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Administration: Participates in the day\-to\-day administrative operations of the department, including in\-house actions required for the permanent collection's maintenance and exhibition; correspondence pertaining to incoming and outgoing loans; inquiries from other institutions, the press, and the public, following institutional and departmental protocol and procedures.
* Research: Participates in the preparation of exhibition research, loans, and related educational materials. Prepares digital presentations, vets art books to be ordered for the Library, and directs research projects.
* Outside Requests: Assists in corresponding with scholars or members of the public regarding objects in the collection. In collaboration with the Assistant Curator, coordinates appointments for the Roberts Seminar Room and hosts classes/groups as necessary.
* Permanent Collection and Documentation: Works with the Registration Department to ensure proper documentation of the collection, including acquisitions, deaccessioning, research, and logistics. Working knowledge of The Museum System (TMS) collections management system is ideal. Maintains departmental files.
* Generates and tracks work progress of technician, conservation, publications, and photo requests, as well as purchase orders required to engage the assistance of other Museum departments in Asana.

* Achenbach Graphic Arts Council: provides administrative support for the Achenbach curatorial support group, liaising with board members, and assisting in organizing board meetings and programs.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  

Minimum Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in art history and knowledge of graphic arts required; Master’s Degree in Art History preferred.
* Work Experience: At least 2 years of curatorial or academic research experience or other relevant museum experience.

  

Skills and Abilities:

* Good general knowledge of the history and culture of the graphic arts.
* Responsive to supervision and flexible in meeting shifting priorities.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with others.
* Exceptional organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with both traditional and contemporary methods of art history research.
* Ability to conduct directed and independent research.
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced work environment with strong follow\-through.
* Exceptional energy, initiative and productivity.
* Ability to achieve and sustain best curatorial practices.
* Strong communication and computer skills, strong customer service orientation.
* Strong arts / aesthetic background and interests.
* Familiarity with standard museum operations and practices is essential.
* Fluency with project management databases (such as Asana) and collections management systems (such as TMS) is preferred.

  

Additional:

  

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Hybrid schedules are a minimum of 4 days a week onsite, with the understanding that schedules may change based on operational needs. The workweek is Monday \- Friday, 8 hours a day, 40 hours per week. This is a 1\-year fixed\-term position, November 2026 \- November 2027\.


Compensation: This is a union position eligible for the Museums' benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance and a generous time off package. There is a 7\-step union pay scale for this position: Step 1 (starting rate) is $28\.73 per hour, Step 7 (max rate) is $38\.50\. Generally, new employees start at the beginning of the pay scale.


Application Deadline: Friday, September 25 at 9 PM PST. We plan to launch the interview process in October.  

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources @ famsf.org.

  

\_\_\_


COFAM is the Corporation of Fine Arts Museums and is the privately funded non\-profit corporation which supports the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco, a department of the City and County of San Francisco.


COFAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all phases of employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Comprising the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park, we are the largest public arts institution in the City of San Francisco and one of the largest art museums in the United States. The de Young, designed by Herzog \& de Meuron and located in Golden Gate Park, showcases American art from the 17th through the 21st centuries, international contemporary art, textiles and costumes, and art from the Americas, the Pacific, and Africa. The Legion of Honor displays a collection of over 4,000 years of ancient and European art including Auguste Rodin's The Thinker and houses the Achenbach Foundation for Graphic Arts in a Beaux\-Arts style building overlooking Lincoln Park and the Golden Gate Bridge.

ACs will use their knowledge of US Foods’ customer contracts, products, services, and tools to support the selling process.
This position has been segmented as hybrid meaning the work is a combination of approximately 90 percent remote/virtual and 10 percent onsite at distribution center offices located anywhere in the West Region of the United States as follows: Anchorage AK, Everett WA, Fife WA, Spokane WA, Billings MT, Portland OR, Salt Lake City UT, Albuquerque NM, Lubbock TX, Phoenix AZ, Las Vegas NV, Corona CA, Los Angeles CA, Fontana CA, San Francisco CA, Sacramento CA, Reno NV, Fresno CA within a 50 mile distance to the listed Distribution Offices.

 **This role will most likely be in the office approximately 1 time per month or occasionally for training.**

**Work Schedule:** Monday \- Friday and hours are approximately 7AM PST \- 4PM PST


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES


Daily Operations – 5%


Focus on the timely and accurate completion of transactional support including, but not limited to:


Service request: Monitor AC service requests and take ownership of assigned AE requests


Corporate requests: Monitor customer requirements for assigned AEs / customers provided from USF’s National Sales corporate office (Air Traffic Control\-ATC). Take timely and accurate action as directed


Sales Support – 70%


Sales planning: Participate in weekly AE collaboration calls, proactively monitor assigned AE’s planned customer visits / activities, and take actions to drive profitable growth


Customer impressions: Contribute to the company's outbound customer impression goals by initiating pre\-planned customer interaction.


Reporting and analytics: Produce and analyze customer\-specific reports to facilitate the following opportunities: maximizing customer’s contracted product utilization, decreasing slow/dead inventory, improving service levels, tracking complicated orders (customer events, large special orders), and additional reporting as needed by AEs and National Sales corporate office.


Customer business reviews (CBRs): Prepare CBRs for AE’s upcoming customer sales calls, producing materials from existing templates, tracking completion of reviews and providing detailed analysis on the impact to sales; Monitor follow\-up from business reviews, including tracking post review activities, action items and communicating to relevant stakeholders to ensure successful follow\-up and resolution.


Customer product / services: Utilize customer relationship management platform to proactively analyze customer product and service recommendations based on customer\-specific knowledge and leverage USF’s e\-commerce platform to present opportunities to customers.


Customer profitability: Make informed product conversion recommendations to AEs to drive profitability; leverage product research on key attributes (nutritionals, price, exclusive brands, compliance, etc.). Monitor follow\-up from product conversions including coordinating new item requests, submitting customer’s forecasted volume to Replenishment (DCTs), and updating customer lists / order guides.


Customer rebates: Analyze quarterly bank statements and other rebate programs to identify opportunities to grow profitable sales, make recommendations to AE and customers.


Customer promotions (Limited Time Offers \- LTOs): Coordinate and track LTOs and new/discontinued items in conjunction with other functions.


Customer shopping lists: Set up and proactively maintain customer’s master shopping lists and/or order guides to prevent out\-of\-stocks during customer’s ordering cycle; partner with Merchandising to find acceptable customer product substitutes.


Customer proprietary inventory: Monitor customer’s proprietary slow moving and dead inventory. Produce product listings and usage to AE and customer. Make recommendations to convert slow items to USF’s exclusive brands to optimize customer’s service level.

Customer pricing / credits: Resolve customer pricing concerns with Customer Operations. Upload mass credit/debit requests, as needed.


Accounts Receivable: Partner with cross functional teams to investigate and resolve credit related issues.


New customers: Partner with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate new customer set\-up, on\-boarding, and maintenance.


Prospective customers: Analyze prospective customer’s product requirements and produce recommended order guides.


Other duties as assigned


Customer Retention – 20%


Identification of at\-risk customers: Proactively identify at\-risk customers based on churn indicators, including tracking category declines, poor service level and skip days; communicate and make recommendations to AEs of at\-risk accounts to be fed into SOS processes and Customer Satisfaction routine


Personal Development – 5%


Engage in formal US Foods performance management programs


Actively participate in personal development through conversations with leadership and contributing to the creation of individual development plans


Attend sales meetings to keep apprised of sales strategies and product trainings / cuttings to develop and grow product / vendor knowledge


RELATIONSHIPS


Internal: Customer Contact personnel, National Sales, National Credit, National Customer Maintenance, Merchandising, Replenishment, Revenue Management/ Pricing, Warehouse, Transportation, Finance/Inventory Control and other functions as required

We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world's software.

jobs.title: Field Marketing & Growth Lead
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


San Francisco hard tech is the most alive it has been in years, and Sift just opened an office in the middle of it. We already know how to throw a great event. What we have not done is make the energy travel: the room fills, the night lands, and none of it shows up on Twitter, where the hard tech conversation actually compounds. This is a growth role that fixes that. You will own our events and field program, our hosted community nights out of our SF office, and the job of turning every room we are in into content that moves online. Vibe and funnel carry equal weight here, because they feed each other: the vibe fills the room, the room fills the funnel, and the funnel pays for the next room. You will carry an event\-sourced pipeline number set with the Head of Sales and a talent contribution target set with the Head of Talent.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the annual event calendar, budget, and the return on it. Run our internal event scoring framework and make the call on every booth, walk, and pass with a rationale attached.
* Build and run our owned event program: dinners, roundtables, and hosted formats that fill without depending on account executives sending personal invites the week of.
* Stand up a recurring San Francisco community program out of our SF office, so the Bay Area hardware and autonomy community has a Sift night on its calendar.
* Make every event ship to the feed. Every event we host or attend produces clips, photos, and posts on Twitter within days. If it was worth hosting, it is worth posting.
* Grow Sift’s Twitter presence into something that carries the energy of the SF hard tech scene, and get the team posting alongside the company account.
* Partner with RevOps to close our attribution gap so every booth, dinner, and sponsorship maps to opportunities and event\-sourced pipeline is a number we can state.
* Turn booth execution into a system: owned assets, a shipping and staffing runbook, a quarterly collateral kit, consistent lead capture, and follow\-up within 48 hours.
* Help Shape employer brand: build the Working at Sift and Why I Joined programs into a real cadence, and make the engineers the protagonists of our content.
* Own speaking submissions and sponsorships, coordinated with comms.
* Treat all of it as a growth portfolio: measure each program, kill what does not convert, and double down on what does.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 4\+ years in field marketing, growth, events, brand, or community, with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a number.
* Time inside a company during the stretch when it became a place people wanted to work, with a clear account of what you specifically owned.
* Proof you can make an IRL moment travel online: events you ran that became posts people actually saw, shared, and showed up because of.
* A real presence on or fluency with Twitter, especially the hard tech and defense tech corners of it.
* A track record of running a hosted format people ask to be invited to.
* A real Bay Area network in hard tech, defense tech, robotics, or autonomy.
* Equal comfort with vibe and funnel: has made things that were simply great, and has shipped work with attribution behind it, and refuses to choose between the two.
* Production instinct: comfortable directing video, photography, and editorial and getting it out the door fast.
* Operational exactness: contracts, deposits, shipping deadlines, badge scanners, vendor invoices.
* Comfort in the CRM and marketing automation stack, building your own invite lists and running your own campaigns.
* Willingness to travel: roughly one show a month in season, plus regular time in LA and periodic trips to DC.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience marketing in NDA\-constrained environments, where much of what customers do cannot be named on a banner.
* Experience opening a new market or city for a company previously concentrated in one place.
* Existing relationships with venue, production, and experiential vendors in San Francisco.
* Experience running partner and co\-marketing motions, including shared booths and co\-hosted events.

**Location:**
-------------


This role is based in our San Francisco office at 211 Sutter Street and is in person four days a week. Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (next to LAX); expect regular travel to LA, roughly one industry event per month in season, and periodic travel to Washington, DC. We come together as a company for a full week every three months.


Salary range: $125,000 \- $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

------------------------------------------------------


FACE FOUNDRIÉ is looking for a creative, organized, and driven Marketing Coordinator to join our team. jobs.description:
**Territory Account Manager** **– Public Sector (SLED) Focused**


**FLSA STATUS: Exempt**


**Location: Livermore, CA**

  


**WHO WE ARE:**



MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Through client partnerships, MGT’s almost 1,200 employees impact communities for good by managing and securing critical networks, solving complex human capital and fiscal problems, elevating education systems, and advancing equity as a performance imperative. MGT partners with thousands of agencies as a trusted advisor delivering solutions that improve technology, operational, and economic performance to help communities thrive.



Founded in 1975, MGT initiated an ambitious restart in 2016, broadening the solutions portfolio to provide the most specialized solutions, tackling the most mission\-critical problems that live at the top of the public agency leadership agenda. MGT drives over 20% compound annual organic growth and utilizes programmatic mergers and acquisitions to grow capabilities, attract top talent, and accelerate growth scale. Since 2020, MGT has successfully completed 13 acquisitions, driving over 60% compound annual inorganic growth.



Celebrating its 50th year in 2025, the firm attracts exceptional talent and empowers them to exceed client expectations as they navigate the dynamic demands of the clients we serve. Hear more about MGT’s culture in the words of ouremployees (https://www.mgt.us/careers/).

  


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



A Territory Account Manager is a hunter\-focused sales role designed to accelerate growth across an assigned geographic territory by identifying, developing, and winning new business within the State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) market. This position is thrives on prospecting, building relationships from the ground up, and creating opportunities within largely untapped ("white space") accounts. The Territory Account Manager is responsible for executing strategic business development initiatives, establishing trusted relationships with technology and business decision\-makers, and positioning MGT as a preferred technology advisor.

jobs.title: Technical Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sift's Business Development Representatives are the front line of our enterprise sales team. You'll own a portfolio of named accounts across aerospace, defense, and industrial engineering, building relationships with the teams designing rockets, satellites, autonomous systems, and other mission\-critical hardware.


This isn't mindless outbound. Success comes from curiosity, research, and good judgment. You'll learn how complex engineering organizations buy software, identify the right technical and executive stakeholders, and secure conversations through thoughtful, personalized outreach. You'll partner closely with an Account Executive to develop account strategy, travel to industry events and customer sites, and use AI\-assisted tooling to research accounts and scale high\-quality outreach.


As one of our early GTM hires, you'll work closely with sales leadership, gain exposure to full enterprise deal cycles, and build the technical and commercial foundation to grow into an Account Executive, sales leadership, or other GTM roles as you succeed.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own a portfolio of named accounts and drive the outreach strategy for each, from first touch to qualified meeting
* Map account org structures: identify decision\-makers, champions, and technical stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and program leadership
* Prioritize accounts using signals like funding, new leadership, program announcements, and industry news
* Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next
* Run personalized, multi\-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn) tailored to the technical buyer, not generic sequences
* Partner closely with your assigned AE: align on account strategy, keep pipeline visibility current, and ensure a clean handoff once a meeting is booked (join the first call as needed, but the AE owns prep)
* Keep CRM and account records current and accurate
* Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 1\-4 years in a customer\-facing, high\-performance environment (B2B sales development, consulting, program or capture support, or similar)
* Strong written communication; able to write outreach that reads as specific and researched, not templated
* Comfortable owning a portfolio and prioritizing without heavy oversight
* Highly self\-motivated, hardworking, and driven, with a track record of finding creative approaches when the obvious path doesn't work
* Genuine curiosity about hard tech, aerospace, defense, or industrial engineering
* Willing to travel for events and customer visits

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience selling into or supporting government/defense programs
* Familiarity with account mapping or capture strategy in complex, multi\-stakeholder orgs
* Experience with Clarify, Salesforce, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

**Location:**
-------------


Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week every three months. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.


Salary range: $75,000 \- $125,000 base, plus $25,000\-$50,000 bonus per year, plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $75K \- $125K

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Strategist is an individual contributor responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing multi\-channel campaigns that work seamlessly across digital and offline touchpoints. This role turns business goals into cohesive, full\-funnel strategies that connect paid, owned, and earned media to drive awareness, engagement, and conversion. This position contributes to website, digital marketing (including SEO), and social media efforts. This individual will work with the SVP of Marketing to proactively identify areas for campaign optimization. This is a highly cross\-functional role supporting a diverse set of initiatives, enabling collaboration with all levels and groups across the organization while remaining hands\-on.  


**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  


* **Education and/or Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in marketing or business administration or closely related fields of study, minimum of 7 years’ experience in marketing with a focus on digital channels.
* **Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:** None required.
* **Geographical Location:** This position may be eligible for a flexible work arrangement. **Individuals working in this position must be located within the state of California.**

  


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
* Support a strong and consistent brand identity across all digital channels.
* Support digital strategy with execution across website, social media, email, and digital media channels, including SEO.
* Support alignment with business strategies and cross\-functional team communication objectives.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**  


**Integrated Campaign Strategy**
* Translate business objectives into integrated campaign strategies that align messaging, timing, and targeting across channels (web, email, social, search, display, content, and select offline).
* Develop clear campaign briefs outlining target audiences, value propositions, key messages, offers, channels, and measurement plans.
* Support end\-to\-end content production, working with external design resources to deliver content. Drive high\-quality creation of content for the website, social and email marketing campaigns.
* Review, write, and edit digital content for typographical, brand tone and voice, and graphic consistency – e.g., site content, SEO keywords and ad messaging, digital banner content, social posts.
* Work with digital agencies to develop content (both copy and images) that are aligned with brand strategy and business objectives.
* Implement digital marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand identity and integration with traditional media marketing channels.
* Map campaigns to the customer journey, ensuring coordinated tactics for acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention.
* Recommend audience segmentation and personalization strategies to improve relevance and performance.

  


**Planning, Execution, and Orchestration**
* Partner with channel owners (email, paid media, social, web, events, branches/sales) to coordinate timelines and deliverables.
* Ensure creative concepts and assets are appropriately adapted for each channel while maintaining a cohesive campaign narrative.
* Optimize performance, identifying opportunities for campaign optimization and reinvestment of digital media.
* Oversee campaign setup and quality assurance (QA) across platforms, ensuring correct targeting, tracking, and deployment.

  


**Optimization and Performance Management**
* Recommend KPIs for each campaign and channel, aligned to funnel stages (reach, engagement, leads, applications, conversions, loyalty).
* Monitor performance regularly, identifying optimization opportunities across audiences, creative, messaging, and channel mix.
* Lead A/B and multivariate tests (subject lines, landing pages, calls to action (CTAs), formats) and document learnings for future campaigns.
* Prepare clear, actionable performance readouts with insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

  


**Collaboration and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Work closely with the SVP of Marketing to ensure campaigns support business and operational goals.
* Coordinate with creative teams to provide strategic direction, feedback, and context for assets and content.
* Partner with analytics/BI teams to refine attribution, reporting, and insight generation across channels.

  


**Governance, Process, and Best Practices**
* Maintain campaign and asset documentation, including briefs, timelines, and post\-campaign reports.
* Help standardize processes for intake, prioritization, approvals, and launch to improve speed and consistency.
* Ensure all campaigns follow brand guidelines, legal/compliance requirements, and data privacy standards.
* Stay current on digital marketing trends, emerging channels, and platform changes, bringing new ideas to test.
* Maintain working knowledge of regulatory compliance related to member services and financial services areas.
* Ensure that Mirastar’s brand and professional reputation are maintained across digital platforms.
* Resolve questions, requests, and problems courteously and within the given timeline.
* Provide project management support to ensure deadlines are met and perform other related duties as requested or assigned.
* Comply with the Bank Secrecy Act, OFAC, and USA PATRIOT Act, including but not limited to reporting suspicious activities to your supervisor and BSA Officer.

  


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
====================================


* Expertise in digital and direct marketing channels.
* Strong knowledge of how to use online analytical tools (Google Analytics, FB reporting, etc.).
* Must be able to anticipate project needs

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

At Workday, we are transforming how businesses worldwide manage their operations. Our Sales Development team is at the heart of that mission. We are looking for individuals with a passion for strategic prospecting, a curiosity for creative thinking, and the motivation to help us advance Workday's mission together.
  

  

As part of our team, you will dive into the work of connecting with decision\-makers through phone and email, building meaningful relationships with potential clients. We introduce Workday's solutions to businesses and offer them new paths to operational efficiency and growth. We count on every team member to make that happen!
  

  

We are a collaborative community built on teamwork and forward thinking. We surround ourselves with industry experts and innovators, and we invest in each other's growth. We prioritize both personal and professional development because we believe that when our people grow, our team grows.
**About the Role**

As a Sales Development Representative, you will join our team in deploying various prospecting approaches across target accounts, partnering with our Account Executives to build quality opportunities for the Workday sales team. Your key role is to connect with potential customers and share our value messaging while also discovering the needs of the prospect and their organization.


Together, we generate a quality pipeline through a combination of email, phone calls, marketing qualified leads, social selling, and face\-to\-face events. We identify qualified potential buyers and develop the relationship between the account and our broader Workday team.


**In this role, you will be responsible for:**

* Deploying multi\-channel prospecting strategies across target accounts, including phone, email, social selling, and in\-person events
* Partnering with our Account Executives to build and advance quality opportunities for Workday field sales
* Contacting potential customers and sharing our value messaging while uncovering prospects' needs and organizational challenges
* Identifying and qualifying potential buyers to help us generate a healthy and growing pipeline
* Nurturing and developing relationships between prospective accounts and our Workday team
* Responding to and qualifying marketing qualified leads in a timely and effective manner
* Diligent to detail with a focus on staying organized while managing multiple prospecting activities and accounts simultaneously

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1\+ year of professional or industry\-related experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 2\+ years of equivalent work experience where a degree is not present
* Experience in prospecting, inside sales, business development, high\-technology environments, marketing, direct sales, or IT consulting
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce.com, Clari Groove, and ZoomInfo
* Effective verbal and written communication skills

**Other Qualifications**

* **Building Pipeline:** Ability to identify potential leads, nurture them through early\-stage engagement, and develop a consistent and growing pipeline through outreach activities.
* **Relationship Building:** Ability to establish meaningful connections with prospects and internal team members through empathy, effective communication, and trust.
* **Business Acumen:** Willingness to learn and understand customer environments, market trends, and organizational landscapes to position Workday effectively in prospecting conversations.
* **Value Propositions:** Ability to identify and articulate the unique value of our solutions in a way that resonates with different audiences and addresses customer needs.
* **Credibility:** Ability to build confidence with prospects and partners through consistency, integrity, and a commitment to continuously developing your knowledge.
* **Other Qualifications**

* If you are a new university graduate with a degree completion between December 2024 \- June 2026, take a look at our Early Career Associate opportunities! Check back periodically, as postings are available on an ongoing basis.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

We're looking for a Research Coordinator to join our Research Operations team in San Francisco, with a dedicated focus on hardware research programs. Our Research Operations team designs and executes the human research studies that power Oura's next\-generation sensor development and scientific innovation, and bolster our scientific credibility. This role supports early\-stage exploration of novel device and sensor form factors, helping validate new hardware concepts and enhance the accuracy of our algorithms. jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Under the direction of an assigned supervisor, assist in the care and supervision of infants, preschool and school\-age children at an assigned childcare center or other learning environment; assist with planning and implementing a variety of activities to meet the needs and interests of the children; perform a variety of clerical support duties.


**Examples of Duties**
----------------------


ESSENTIAL DUTIES:


Assist in the care and supervision of infants, preschool and school\-age children at an assigned childcare center or other learning environment; assist in opening and closing assigned classroom; set up and put away toys, learning materials and equipment.


Assist with planning and implementing a variety of activities to meet the needs and interests of the children; assist children with homework and classroom assignments; read age\-appropriate stories to students; prepare classroom for naptime.


Perform a variety of clerical duties such as preparation of instructional materials, duplicating materials, taking attendance and maintaining student records and files.


Assure the health and safety of students by following established practices and procedures; maintain learning environment in a safe, orderly and clean manner; perform light housekeeping duties including washing dishes, clearing lunch tables, cleaning mats and workstations, sweeping floors and cleaning sinks.


Observe and control behavior of students in the classroom and during outdoor activities according to approved procedures; report progress regarding student performance and behavior; participate in parent conferences as assigned.


Assist students regarding the building of self\-esteem; assist students by providing proper examples, emotional support, friendly attitude and general guidance; respond to a child's needs and problems in a patient, caring and sensitive manner.


Assist with snack and lunch time as assigned; escort children to the cafeteria for breakfast as assigned; clean up eating areas and wash children's hands and faces after play times and meals as needed; assist children with toileting as needed, change diapers and soiled clothing as needed.


Oversee groups of children in games and play activities; assure safe outdoor play; accompany students on field trips as assigned; administer basic first aid as needed.


Interpret and explain classroom activities to parents and visitors including techniques of individual instruction and small group instruction in the areas of manipulative play, creative art, block building, dramatic play, science and language arts.


Operate a variety of classroom and office equipment including a computer, copier, audio\-visual equipment.


OTHER DUTIES:


Attend and participate in a variety of in\-service trainings, staff meetings and childcare center functions.


Perform related duties as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:


KNOWLEDGE OF:


Basic principles and practices of early child development including proper care and discipline.


Child guidance principles and practices.


Safe practices in classroom and playground activities.


Basic subjects taught in District schools, including arithmetic, grammar, spelling, language and reading.


Basic instructional methods and techniques.


Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary.


Classroom procedures and appropriate student conduct.


Operation of standard office and classroom equipment.


Oral and written communication skills.


Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy.


Basic record\-keeping techniques.


ABILITY TO:


Provide quality child care and a safe environment for children in an assigned child care center or other learning environment.


Assist with instruction and related activities in a classroom or assigned learning environment.


Reinforce instruction to individual or small groups of students as directed by the teacher.


Understand and follow oral and written directions.


Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.


Be flexible to perform work within changing priorities and possess sufficient interpersonal skill to work harmoniously with staff, students, administrators, parents and others.


Communicate effectively both orally and in writing.


Monitor, observe and report student behavior and progress according to approved policies and procedures.


Operate standard office and classroom equipment.


Observe health and safety regulations.


Perform clerical duties related to classroom activities.


Maintain routine records.


Learn first aid and CPR techniques.


**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:


Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school and completion of (6\) or more semester units of ECE or child development for Level I and completion of (12\) or more semester units of ECE or child development and an Associate Teacher Permit for Level II.


Level I\-Work with school age children


Level II\-Work with infants and pre\-school children


LICENSES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS:


Valid First Aid and CPR Certificate issued by an authorized agency within six months of employment for Level I and at the time of hiring for Level II.


WORKING CONDITIONS:


ENVIRONMENT:


Classroom and playground environment.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:


Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate classroom equipment.


Sitting or standing for extended periods of time.


Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching to assist students.


Seeing to read a variety of materials and monitor student activities.


Hearing and speaking to exchange information.
