jobs.title: Business Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**  

  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874\. As the \#1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. \#WeAreADT
*Check out more about life at ADT* here.
**What you should know about our team:**


At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.


**What you will do:**


You’ll use your strong communication and creative problem\-solving skills to demonstrate the value of our innovative security and smart business solutions to small business customers while explaining our products and services in depth and recommending the right options for their needs. You’ll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, partnering closely with business owners, decision\-makers, and teammates. This role involves providing tailored solutions by visiting customers at their businesses. You will:


* Listen and build trust: By showing up with integrity, empathy, and expertise, you’ll become a reliable advisor small business owners can count on throughout the sales process and beyond.
* Customize each system to fit the business’s layout, operations, and security needs, combining security, automation, and life\-safety technology in ways that support how they work.
* Conduct post\-installation follow\-ups with customers to confirm commitments were fulfilled and strengthen long\-term relationships and referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new small business leads within your territory to maximize outreach and growth.

**What you need to be successful:**


We’re looking for self\-motivated, tech\-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast\-paced sales environment.
* Self\-motivated and results\-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**


**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $85,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000\.


**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000\.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and well\-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings.

**Why you’ll love working here:**


* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We **lead by taking ownership**, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We **unite and win together**, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

Los Angeles Applicants: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.


Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance.


**EEO Statement:**


ADT is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ADT strives to ensure every employee and applicant feels valued. Visit us at jobs.adt.com/diversity to learn more.

American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. ===================

**OFFICE OF THE CHIEF JUDGE**  

**CIRCUIT COURT OF COOK COUNTY, ILLINOIS**  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**POSITION TITLE**: Problem\-Solving Court Project Coordinator  

**BUSINESS UNIT**: Problem\-Solving Courts (PSC)  

**POSITION CLASSIFICATION**: Exempt  

**PAY GRADE**: Grade 19  

**Salary:** $80,355 **Location:** Various  

**Hours:** 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. or as assigned  

The Office of the Chief Judge is seeking a project coordinator to provide administrative and operational support to the judges and team members in the Problem\-Solving Courts (Drug Courts, Veterans Courts, and Mental Health Courts) currently operating in the Circuit Court of Cook County. This is a full\-time, limited duration position fully devoted to support the administration and management of the Cook County Adult Redeploy Illinois (ARI) grant funded projects.  

  

**OVERVIEW**  

The Project Coordinator’s responsibilities include troubleshooting and monitoring court operations and achievement of project goals and objectives, assisting the Director of Problem\-Solving with management of daily operations, assisting the team with data collection for the project, grant management, quarterly programmatic and financial reporting, and coordination of interagency and community partnerships to expand substance use disorder (SUD) and behavioral health treatment services.  

  

**ESSENTIAL** **FUNCTIONS**  

The essential functions of the Project Coordinator include the following:* Work with the Director of Problem\-Solving Courts and PSC administration team to implement program activities and coordinate the collection of program data to meet PSC reporting requirements;
* Work collaboratively with a PSC administration team as well as third\-party vendors and partner agencies to meet program and service objectives of the PSC;
* Coordination and management of interagency and community partnerships, including treatment providers and clinical case management providers;
* Attend scheduled court staffings and status calls;
* Monitor and maintain an accurate database of program participants from referral to termination;
* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual ARI performance reports for approval by the program agency prior to dissemination to interested parties or submission to grant funding agencies;
* Work with the Director of Problem\-Solving Courts in the coordination of ongoing education and training for PSC team members to ensure compliance program standards;
* Meet productivity standards as established by the Director of Problem\-Solving.


This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned.  

  

**MINIMUM** **QUALIFICATIONS:**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

Education: Master’s degree in Public Administration (MPA), Public Policy, Criminal Justice, or a Human Services field required; preference to individuals with experience in grant writing, federal/state grant compliance, or non\-profit management.
  

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the human services field required; preference to experience working with adults in criminal justice system, court operations, and/or project management.  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:*** Accuracy, attention to detail and strong organizational skills, including an ability to prioritize and effectively manage multiple projects and tasks
* Knowledge of criminal justice system, court processes and legal terminology preferred
* Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, online collaborative tools, and overall computer skills/technical aptitude
* An ability to act professionally and respectfully
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team to complete project tasks
* Must be able to develop and maintain an effective working relationship with a diverse audience
* Must maintain confidentiality

**QUALIFIED APPLICANTS MUST SUBMIT:*** Letter of interest addressed to Honorable Charles S. Beach II, Chief Judge, Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois, addressing work experience and the qualifications for this position;
* Applicant’s current resume

  

**Other Requirements:**  

Working conditions/physical requirements:  

On a continuous basis, sit at a desk for long periods of time in front of a computer screen;  

Intermittently twist to reach equipment or supplies surrounding desk;  

Perform simple grasping and fine manipulation;  

Strength to lift files weighing up to 20 pounds;  

Use telephone and computer keyboard on a daily basis; and  

Available to work in person 100% of work week.  

  

Late or incomplete application submissions will not be considered. Applicants who meet the minimum qualifications are not guaranteed to advance through all of the steps in the selection process.

jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
Nourishing Hope is a dynamic Chicago nonprofit agency. Nourishing Hope has evolved to become more than solely a hunger relief organization. We provide food, social services such as job and housing assistance, and free mental wellness counseling with a growing team of licensed therapists. Founded in 1970, we strive to serve the needs of the whole person — with respect and dignity, always.  

Nourishing Hope offers our neighbors nutritious food using a choice\-based distribution model and access to life\-changing social services including:* Monthly food distribution and additional produce pickup through five different food access programs.
* Home delivery services for older adults, homebound neighbors and neighbors living with disabilities.
* Social services including case management, mental health counseling, job search support, domestic violence intervention, referrals and public benefits assistance (SNAP, healthcare, government forms) for anyone in need.

  

Nourishing Hope serves tens of thousands of people each year, providing more than 4 million meals through our programs, in addition to partnerships with other community organizations. This year, more than 7,000 low\-income neighbors will also receive case management and social services. **Position Summary**
The Home Delivery Program Coordinator primarily supports the effective delivery of Nourishing Hope’s food distribution programming, including the In\-Person Markets, Home Delivery, and Online Market program models, as appropriate. This role supports all aspects of daily food distribution programming for Home Delivery, including neighbor and volunteer engagement, operations and logistics, data tracking and reporting, and food safety and sanitation. This role acts as a liaison to all neighbors, volunteers, staff, and other stakeholders to ensure a dignified and respectful experience. **Schedule and Locations**
This position is primarily based at our Hub location at 5151 N. Ravenswood. The typical schedule is Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday from 9:00 AM–5:30 PM, and Wednesday and Saturday from 8:00 AM–4:30 PM. This is a fully onsite position and may also require work at partner sites or occasional work at other Nourishing Hope locations based on program needs. **Essential Job Functions:*** Supports adherence to and execution of all relevant food distribution program standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure high\-quality programming, food storage, workplace safety, and sanitation standards that adhere to organizational, state, and federal policy.
* Acts as a frontline point of contact for all neighbors, providing assistance and guidance, while effectively managing expectations regarding program processes, service availability, and other pertinent information with transparency and clarity. Fosters a welcoming environment for everyone, anchored in empathy and dignity.
* Supports the training and supervision of volunteers and new program staff to assist with food distribution programming, in alignment with SOPs. Acts as the manager on duty, as appropriate.
* Using required technology platforms, accurately inputs or maintains neighbor and programmatic data, produces and submits required reports, and tracks benchmarks/key performance indicators.
* Appropriately supports inventory and relationships with The Greater Chicago Food Depository, U.S.D.A., FEMA, and other external partners.

 **Qualifications:*****Required:**** High School diploma/GED or equivalent, college degree preferred.
* 2\-5 years work experience in social services, food service/distribution, or grocery/retail environments.
* Valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and ability to drive a van.
* Strong technology skills including:
	+ Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Google Suite.
	+ Ability to use and maintain Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) data quality.
* An understanding of, and belief in, the importance of food security for everyone.
* Familiarity with the interconnected barriers experienced by neighbors experiencing food insecurity, including but not limited to homelessness, mental and physical health, disability, substance use, and aging\-related barriers.
* Ability to obtain and maintain food service sanitation certification in accordance with municipal and state laws.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (in person, over the phone, remotely, and in writing) and the ability to navigate challenging situations with patience and professionalism.
* Proven ability to work independently and as a member of a team, including willingness to provide staff coverage, depending on programmatic need.
* Ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment with frequent interruptions.
* A high level of professionalism, attention to detail, and a high degree of accuracy.

jobs.title: Grant Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position/Summary**
The Grants Development Coordinator is primarily responsible for identifying funding opportunities, coordinating grant applications, supporting proposal development, and maintaining an organized grant\-development pipeline. This position is primarily own the pre\-award process—prospecting, proposal coordination, writing, application management, and submission.
**Responsibilities Include but are not limited to:**
* Research federal, state, local, foundation, corporate, and private funding opportunities.
* Monitor funding announcements from HRSA, HHS, SAMHSA, HUD, state agencies, foundations, and other funders.
* Assess opportunities for preliminary alignment with organizational priorities, programs, and strategic goals.
* Maintain a funding opportunity calendar and prospect pipeline.
* Coordinate development of grant applications from concept through submission.
* Work closely with contractual writers to draft and edit narratives, needs statements, organizational descriptions, project goals, objectives, work plans, and sustainability sections.
* Ensure proposals clearly demonstrate community need, organizational capacity, expected outcomes, and measurable impact.
* Coordinate letters of support, MOUs, attachments, certifications, and other required documents
* Establish application timelines and assign responsibilities for each submission.
* Coordinate input from program directors, clinical leadership, Finance, Compliance, HR, IT, and executive leadership.
* Schedule grant\-development meetings and track outstanding deliverables. Ensure all application components are completed before internal and funder deadlines
* Provide Finance with staffing assumptions, program activities, equipment needs, contractual requirements, and other information necessary for budget preparation.
* Ensure the narrative, work plan, and approved budget are consistent.
* Coordinate submission through systems such as Grants.gov, HRSA EHBs, SAM.gov\-related processes, state portals, and foundation platforms.
* Conduct a final completeness review before submission.
* Maintain confirmation of successful submission and copies of final applications.
* Upon receiving award, organize a formal handoff from grant development to Finance, program leadership, and grant management/compliance.
* Provide the approved application, budget, notice of award, deliverables, reporting requirements, performance measures, and key deadlines.
* Participate in grant kickoff meetings to ensure operational teams understand what was committed to the funder.
* Finding and analyzing grants from government agencies, corporations, and private foundations to match organizational needs
* Reviewing text for compliance and ensuring all technical criteria, strict formatting and deadlines are met.
* Writing compelling narratives, gathering program data, and working with the team to build project budgets
* Maintaining a master grants calendar, tracking deadlines, and coordinating information across different departments
* Monitoring award requirements and writing post\-award impact reports for funders.
* Co\-lead community events (Health and Fun Fair, Mobile van coordination and other community events)
* Lead coordinator for planning and organizing community educational programs/projects
* Schedule prospects meeting with foundations between CEO to discuss funding needs.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Minimum of BS degree in English, Communication, Public Administration, or Nonprofit Management. Ability to write persuasive writing and editing skills translate data and community impact into a clear care for support. At least three years of more grantsmanship and working with funding organizations. Knowledge of and experience with EMR and Microsoft Office systems required. Proven understanding with performance measures and patient health outcomes; Experience with community health center and federally qualified health center (FQHC) services/models strongly preferred; Must possess strong organizational, administrative and time management skills; Must possess strong verbal, computer, and communication skills.

* Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental and Vision Insurance

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  

  

Roadrunner is the most tech\-forward company in LTL. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real\-time visibility, and real accountability. The service is differentiated. The point of view is clear. Marketing has not yet fully translated that advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events, and in the materials our teams use.  

  

That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the creative force and operational backbone of the marketing team. You will design, film, write, organize, and ship. You will bring campaigns to life through compelling visual content, tight planning, and cross\-platform execution. You will keep initiatives on\-brand, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE\-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Content Creation \& Brand Presence**
------------------------------------------


This is a creation role, not a maintenance role. You make the brand visible.

* Design and produce marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) for digital and print campaigns.
* Invent and ship high\-impact visual content that advances Roadrunner as the Category of One—graphics, sales collateral, social assets, landing\-page visuals, event materials, and campaign creative.
* Create video and photo content. Appear on camera when needed and direct shoots that capture authentic customer stories, owner\-operator voices, and company culture.
* Support Roadrunner’s LinkedIn and social presence with content that is sharp, human, and on\-brand—not generic freight marketing.
* Shape how the brand shows up across digital, physical, and experiential touchpoints so every interaction reinforces that Roadrunner is leading the way.

**2\. Campaign Execution \& Coordination**
------------------------------------------


The Marketing Manager owns the strategy. You make the machine run.

* Coordinate with vendors, internal stakeholders, sales, talent acquisition, and the marketing team to execute multi\-channel campaigns on time.
* Support integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, content, events, and emerging channels that drive awareness, pipeline, and talent outcomes.
* Treat every campaign as an experiment. Track what shipped, what worked, and what needs to change. Document what you learn.
* Produce materials and communications for strategic customer accounts based on direction from leadership and the Marketing Manager.

**3\. Website, Social \& Digital Presence**
-------------------------------------------


Keep the public face of the brand fresh, usable, and current.

* Manage and update the website CMS so content is accurate, optimized, and user\-friendly.
* Support social media content creation and campaign execution across platforms—planning, producing, scheduling, and reporting.
* Help build and maintain landing pages and digital experiences that match Roadrunner’s voice and convert attention into action.
* Use AI tools to accelerate production without sacrificing quality, voice, or point of view.

**4\. Calendar, Systems \& Operational Support**
------------------------------------------------


You are the detail\-oriented backbone. Nothing falls through the cracks.

* Own the marketing calendar and project\-management systems. Keep deadlines visible. Keep work moving.
* Help maintain reusable content resources, brand guidelines, and AI prompt frameworks so internal teams can produce on\-brand materials without bottlenecks.
* Apply AI and automation to recurring production and administrative work—reducing manual effort and shortening turnaround time.
* Track marketing expenses and assist with budget reconciliation.
* Identify friction in how marketing work gets done, then fix it with process, templates, and tools that stick.

**5\. Talent, Owner\-Operator \& Culture Content**
--------------------------------------------------


Attract the right people. Help them stay. Make the culture visible.

* Produce recruitment marketing creative that attracts high\-quality CDL drivers, owner operators, and key employees.
* Create targeted assets and content for owner\-operator acquisition and retention campaigns.
* Partner with talent acquisition and operations to support employee recruiting with clear, compelling materials.
* Capture and produce culture content—photos, video, recognition assets, newsletter visuals—that reinforces We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together.
* Support internal communications with polished, on\-brand assets so employees and owner operators feel informed and seen.

**What you bring**
==================

* Proven experience in a marketing or related creative role, with a portfolio that shows you can make work, not only talk about it.
* Significant creative skill in Canva and comfort in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro).
* Confidence both in front of and behind the camera for video and photography.
* CMS experience and proven website management skills.
* Event marketing experience, especially direct customer engagement and activation.
* Experience creating content for social platforms and running work across multiple channels at once.
* Detail\-oriented process and project\-management muscle. You keep calendars, files, vendors, and deadlines tight.
* Strong writing and visual storytelling. You can make industrial and technology stories feel sharp and human.
* Comfort using AI tools to create, iterate, and scale content without losing quality or brand voice.
* Comfort operating in a lean, fast\-moving environment where you wear multiple hats and invent process as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Great to have: HubSpot or similar marketing automation, Google Analytics,

jobs.title: Account Manager, SMB
jobs.description:
**About Grubhub**

  

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried\-and\-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high\-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

  

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy\-to\-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

 **The Impact You Will Make:**

* Develop a solid understanding of Grubhub's products and services, including their features, benefits, and value propositions.
* Assist in managing a portfolio of accounts, ensuring timely communication, and addressing basic inquiries or concerns from clients.
* Assist restaurants in attracting new diners, boosting order volume, and delivering top\-quality service to their diners.
* Conduct regular check\-ins with restaurant partners to gather feedback, assess satisfaction levels, and identify areas for improvement.
* Respond to restaurant inquiries, account issues, and requests or route them to appropriate company departments within turnaround time expectations.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of client interactions, including notes on discussions, action items, and follow\-up tasks.
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance product knowledge, sales skills, and overall proficiency in account management practices.
* Proactively seek opportunities to contribute to team goals and initiatives, demonstrating a willingness to learn and grow in the role.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* Native\-level fluency in English is required. Candidates fluent in Mandarin or Spanish are strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience and High School degree/GED required
* 2\-4 years of Sales or Account Manager experience. Experience working with (or selling to) restaurant owners is a major plus. Restaurant experience is also a plus.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, Google products) with the ability to quickly learn new software. Experience with Salesforce.com or similar CRM is a plus.
* Native\-level fluency in English is required. Candidates fluent in Mandarin or Spanish are strongly preferred.
* Ability and desire to do whatever it takes to find solutions for restaurants.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident making outbound dials on the phone.
* Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals.
* Impeccable organizational skills, easily balancing multiple tasks at once; self\-starter with a strong bias towards action and problem\-solving; maximizes effectiveness by focusing time in the right areas.
* Outstanding, positive attitude with passion and aptitude for working in a fast\-paced and fast\-growing environment.

**Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.**


We reward our Sales positions with competitive pay. For this role, we offer uncapped commission with a base salary range as outlined below.


New York: $70,400\- 88,000 ($88,000\-$110,000 OTE)


Illinois: $ 64,000 \- $80,000 ($80,000 \- $100,000 OTE)


Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

  

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

  

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

 **A Final Note**


At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

**We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager - Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
**ADP is hiring a Sales Operations Manager – Governance Specialist** as part of the Sales Enablement team within Worldwide Commercial Operations. Defines AI content guardrails, risk, controls, compliance, workflows, and escalation paths.


\*\*This is a hybrid position, 3 days per week in the office and 2 days per week from home. Qualified candidates must live within commutable distance to one of our commercial offices and be willing to work on a hybrid schedule.\*\*


**Role Purpose:**


* Ensures all AI\-generated outputs meet legal, compliance, and brand standards while maintaining safe and ethical AI practices.
* Defines governance frameworks, risk controls, and escalation paths for AI\-generated content.
* Builds trust and scalability by embedding compliance into AI workflows.

**Key Focus Areas:**


* AI content compliance and risk management
* Governance frameworks and approval workflows
* Bias, hallucination, and data privacy risk mitigation
* Policy definition and enforcement

**Core Deliverables:**


* Governance policies and compliance frameworks for AI outputs
* Approval and escalation workflows for sensitive content
* Risk audit findings and mitigation recommendations
* Documentation for traceability and version control

**Ways of Working:**


* Partners with legal and compliance teams to define standards
* Conducts audits and monitors for risk signals in AI outputs
* Implements approval layers and human\-in\-the\-loop processes
* Educates stakeholders on governance requirements and best practices

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships:**


* Legal, compliance, and security teams for regulatory alignment
* Agent Enablement and Orchestration teams for workflow integration
* Prompt Engineer to embed guardrails into prompts
* Sales and enablement teams for adoption and awareness

**Success Metrics:**


* Compliance adherence and reduction in risk incidents
* Audit pass rates and governance coverage
* Trust in AI\-generated outputs across stakeholders
* Effectiveness of escalation and approval processes

**Role Interdependencies:**


* AI Messaging Specialist identifies quality and risk signals
* Prompt Engineer embeds guardrails into prompts
* Agent Enablement and Orchestrator implement governance in workflows
* Governance Specialist owns policy, compliance, and risk management

**Qualifications:**


* Experience in compliance, risk management, legal operations, privacy, security governance, content governance, or regulated communications
* Strong understanding of AI risks such as hallucination, bias, privacy exposure, unsupported claims, data leakage, and inaccurate personalization
* Ability to design clear approval tiers and escalation paths
* Experience writing policies, standards, procedures, or governance documentation
* Strong collaboration skills with Legal, Compliance, Security, Product, Enablement, and Sales
* Ability to balance risk reduction with business usability
* Excellent communication and training skills
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, responsible AI frameworks, privacy frameworks, or model risk management
* Experience with GDPR, data privacy, financial services, HR technology, or regulated customer communications
* Experience auditing content, systems, or AI outputs
* Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop controls
* Familiarity with logging, traceability, version control, and exception management

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative (National Retail)
jobs.description:
Build a Better Career as an Outside Sales Representative – National Retail with BlueLinx!
  
  

At BlueLinx, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to ensuring our team members can build job security, enhance their skills, and make meaningful contributions. We deliver the building blocks to better lives.
  
Join us and be part of a company that values its people and strives to make a positive impact in the industry.
  
  

Summary
  
BlueLinx is seeking a driven Outside Sales Representative – National Retail to manage existing national retail relationships while aggressively growing new revenue within the region. This role requires a true hunter mentality motivated by uncovering new opportunities, expanding partnerships, and driving profitable growth.
  
  

The ideal candidate is confident calling on national retailers, engaging previous customers, developing new revenue streams, and strengthening established accounts. Relationship building is critical to success in this role. This position offers a competitive base salary plus commission structure.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Identify new sales opportunities with both new and existing national retail customers, with a focus on program business.
* Maximize sales effectiveness by prioritizing time and effort on the largest and most profitable opportunities, including segmentation of account lists.
* Improve overall profitability, product penetration, and product mix across assigned accounts.
* Qualify sales opportunities through market and customer research and collaboration with insider sales partners.
* Develop sales solutions and competitive pricing strategies; articulate value propositions to customers.
* Present and propose sales solutions to customers and adjust strategies as needed based on customer feedback and market conditions.
* Close sales opportunities by securing purchase orders and ensuring all order fulfillment procedures are executed accurately.
* Provide outstanding post sale service and support to ensure long term customer satisfaction and repeat business.


What We’re Looking For
  
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent industry experience strongly preferred.
* 0–2 years of experience in a sales role with responsibility for growing accounts and generating new business.
* Ability to manage an existing book of business while expanding partnerships.
* Building materials or related industry experience is a plus.
* Strong market knowledge, product familiarity, and consultative selling skills.
* Demonstrated “hunter” mentality with a strong drive for results.
* Excellent planning, organization, communication, problem solving, and decision making skills.
* Working knowledge of account management, customer service, product pricing, sales support, warehousing, distribution, and transportation.
* Self motivated, disciplined, and performance driven.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and relevant sales systems and technology.
* Strong telephone and communication skills with the ability to identify needs, evaluate solutions, and recommend action.


Why BlueLinx?
  
* 60,000 \- 65,000 plus incentive/commission plan
* Comprehensive benefits package including:
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Life insurance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Company Ownership
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) starting day one and 8 company holidays
* Opportunity to grow your career with a leading national building products distributor


Our Values
  
With every decision and action, we put people first, keep the future in mind, and work as a team toward shared progress:
  
Customer Centric • Respect • Collaboration • Integrity • Grit
  
  

About BlueLinx
  
**BlueLinx (NYSE:** BXC) is a leading wholesale distributor of building and industrial products in the United States. With over 70,000 branded and private label SKUs, we service customers nationwide through an extensive distribution network. Our more than 2,000 associates are critical to our success, and we pride ourselves on a culture rooted in teamwork, integrity, safety, and customer service.
  
  

Compensation Disclosure
  
The salary range provided is a good faith estimate based on position requirements and market data. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and other job related considerations. BlueLinx also offers a comprehensive benefits package starting the first day of the month.
  
  

To report any issues with this job posting, please contact Talent@BlueLinxCo.com

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Specialist**
Access One is a business technology services and telecommunications provider dedicated to delivering world\-class solutions and an award\-winning client experience. Founded in 1993, Access One provides seamless, scalable technological services that evolve with our client's businesses. Our custom\-tailored solutions can be delivered modularly or as a complete, end\-to\-end package, ensuring clear accountability across business phones, communications platforms, managed IT, cybersecurity, security systems, and cloud\-based services. By simplifying technology management, Access One helps businesses reclaim time and increase productivity. Our clients’ success is our success.
The Customer Success Specialist develops and maintains long\-term business relationships by serving as an internal advocate and client liaison. This role will require a hybrid of soft and hard skills required to manage customer relationships. In addition, this role will demonstrate superb communication, organization, and time management skills, with the ability to effectively handle several diverse and complex needs at the same time.
**Job Responsibilities**
* Build relationships with assigned clients, which includes being involved in any customer calls, ranging from onboarding calls, quarterly review calls and more.
* Establish a trusted and strategic advisor relationship to help drive high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and implement customer success strategies and best practices by utilizing regular “check\-ins” for consistent communication. Following up on any and all items that have crossed your path.
* Serve as escalation point for client issues, and work to involve any necessary departments and management teams as needed.
* Communicate effectively with both internal and external senior level management to understand client needs, maximize retention and growth, and communicate learnings.

**Project Manager — Marcel Digital**

*(Hybrid \| Chicagoland candidates only)*


As a Project Manager at Marcel Digital, you’ll support the successful delivery of software development and digital services projects while growing into full, independent ownership over time. You’ve already built a foundation — one to three years in digital marketing, agency work, or digital project delivery — and you’re ready to put it to work.


You’ll work closely with senior project managers, subject matter experts, and cross\-functional teams to coordinate timelines, track progress, and maintain clear communication across stakeholders. You’ll start with meaningful project responsibility from day one, and take on increasing ownership of mid\-size projects and client relationships as your confidence and capabilities grow.

**The expected salary range for this position is $60k \- $80k**

**Role Description**

**Project Management \& Support**


Manage and support the execution of software development and digital services projects — helping manage budget, scope and timelines, tracking deliverables, and ensuring tasks move forward. You’ll play a key role in keeping projects organized and on track.

**Client Communication**


Communicate with clients both individually and alongside senior team members. You’ll document discussions, follow up on action items, and steadily take the lead on more client interactions.

**Planning \& Task Management**


Translate project requirements into actionable tasks. You’ll maintain project plans, support the creation of monthly tasks, keep tools up to date, and ensure team members have clarity on next steps. You’re more than just a traffic cop, you understand the requests to drive work forward and actively manage them through completion and delivery.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


Work closely with developers, designers, and marketing teams to understand how web projects come together. You’ll deepen your familiarity with each discipline and how they contribute to successful delivery.

**Process Adherence**


Follow established project management and agile workflows. As you gain experience, you’ll contribute ideas to improve how projects are managed and delivered.

**Risk Awareness**


Identify potential risks or blockers and escalate them appropriately. You don’t need to solve everything, but you should know when something needs attention.

**Transparency \& Reporting**


Maintain visibility into project status by updating tools, preparing status updates, and ensuring accurate documentation.

**What You’ll Need**

* Minimum 2 years of professional project management experience
* Previous experience working in a digital, marketing, or software agency
* Experience managing digital, website, software development, or digital marketing projects
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong client\-facing communication skills with experience working directly with external stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

**Nice to Have**

* Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced agency environment, with genuine curiosity for how our agency operates and our clients’ business goals
* Growth\-minded and eager to leverage AI to improve day\-to\-day efficiency and productivity
* Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Workfront, Jira, or similar)
* Basic understanding of software development concepts (CMS platforms, front\-end/back\-end roles)
* Basic understanding of paid media channels and/or SEO/AEO
* Knowledge of Nicolas Cage

**Benefits**


Marcel offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible, collaborative work environment. You’ll have meaningful autonomy, influence how projects are delivered to clients, and help shape the future of Marcel’s project management practice.


We value curiosity, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement. If you’re excited about growing into a PM who delivers digital projects clients can actually trust, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Overview:
**If** **You’re** **Great at Sales, We’ve Got the Career for You**


Are you a natural at connecting with people and closing deals? At Orkin, we’ll turn your drive and people skills into a successful, long\-term sales career – with **uncapped earning potential** and the backing of the most recognized name in pest control.


As an Orkin Sales Inspector, you’ll offer homeowners genuine peace of mind by providing trusted protection backed by over 120 years of expertise, the Orkin Guarantee, and a brand customers already trust. You’ll also enjoy award\-winning training, career development, and the satisfaction of helping families protect their most valuable investment, their home.

**Why Orkin?**


At Orkin, we do more than eliminate pests – we protect health, homes, and peace of mind by providing many different services, including:

* Attic cleanouts for wildlife issues
* Crawl space remediation
* Termite treatments and complete pest control solutions
* Full home exclusions using metal and professional\-grade sealants

  

We are driven by a shared mission and grounded in values that define everything we do:

* Safety
* Professionalism
* Empathy
* Integrity
* Innovation

  

With a reputation built over more than a century and a team\-first culture, you’ll feel supported from day one – with the freedom and tools to succeed.


Responsibilities: **What** **You’ll** **Be Doing**

* Conducting full\-home inspections (from attic to crawl space)
* Build trust by explaining your findings clearly and recommending the best treatment options.
* Close sales by showcasing the value, protection, and long\-term benefits of Orkin’s services
* Manage appointments, follow\-ups, and documentation using a company\-provided iPad.
* Work independently, prioritize your schedule, and maximize leads and self\-generated opportunities.
* Represent Orkin with professionalism, empathy, and integrity every step of the way.

 **What’s In It for You?**

* **Top Earning Potential: Average First Year Earnings between $70,000 and $100,000 (base \+ commission)**
* **Uncapped Commission:** The more you sell, the more you earn
* **Company Vehicle:** Gas card included
* **Paid Training:** No pest control experience required – we’ll teach you everything.
* **Benefits that Go Beyond:**
* Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan, tuition reimbursement, and scholarship opportunities
* **Recognition \& Awards:** Top performers can earn exclusive annual incentive trips and advancement opportunities


Qualifications:
**You’d** **Be a Great Fit If You:**

* Love meeting new people and helping solve real problems
* Are confident, competitive, and goal\-driven
* Can work independently and stay organized
* Don’t mind climbing, crawling, or working in various weather conditions.

 **Minimum** **Requirements**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Use a ladder safely within the manufacturer’s weight capacity.
* Lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, rooftops, etc.
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE), which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator.

 **Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer**

We are looking for an ambitious, drive\-oriented Inbound Sales Representative (ISR) to join our Sales team. You will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives on key accounts and operate at the intersection of AI\-powered tooling, a world\-class product, and a transformed go\-to\-market strategy.

* Own and close inbound and transactional opportunities within your assigned book of business, running the full sales cycle with speed and precision.
* Build and drive new pipeline through targeted outbound plays in new logo accounts and large existing footprints, partnering closely with Enterprise and Emerging Enterprise AEs.

* Good general knowledge of the history and culture of the graphic arts.
* Responsive to supervision and flexible in meeting shifting priorities.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with others.

new_jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


San Francisco hard tech is the most alive it has been in years, and Sift just opened an office in the middle of it. We already know how to throw a great event. What we have not done is make the energy travel: the room fills, the night lands, and none of it shows up on Twitter, where the hard tech conversation actually compounds. This is a growth role that fixes that. You will own our events and field program, our hosted community nights out of our SF office, and the job of turning every room we are in into content that moves online. Vibe and funnel carry equal weight here, because they feed each other: the vibe fills the room, the room fills the funnel, and the funnel pays for the next room. You will carry an event\-sourced pipeline number set with the Head of Sales and a talent contribution target set with the Head of Talent.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the annual event calendar, budget, and the return on it. Run our internal event scoring framework and make the call on every booth, walk, and pass with a rationale attached.
* Build and run our owned event program: dinners, roundtables, and hosted formats that fill without depending on account executives sending personal invites the week of.
* Stand up a recurring San Francisco community program out of our SF office, so the Bay Area hardware and autonomy community has a Sift night on its calendar.
* Make every event ship to the feed. Every event we host or attend produces clips, photos, and posts on Twitter within days. If it was worth hosting, it is worth posting.
* Grow Sift’s Twitter presence into something that carries the energy of the SF hard tech scene, and get the team posting alongside the company account.
* Partner with RevOps to close our attribution gap so every booth, dinner, and sponsorship maps to opportunities and event\-sourced pipeline is a number we can state.
* Turn booth execution into a system: owned assets, a shipping and staffing runbook, a quarterly collateral kit, consistent lead capture, and follow\-up within 48 hours.
* Help Shape employer brand: build the Working at Sift and Why I Joined programs into a real cadence, and make the engineers the protagonists of our content.
* Own speaking submissions and sponsorships, coordinated with comms.
* Treat all of it as a growth portfolio: measure each program, kill what does not convert, and double down on what does.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 4\+ years in field marketing, growth, events, brand, or community, with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a number.
* Time inside a company during the stretch when it became a place people wanted to work, with a clear account of what you specifically owned.
* Proof you can make an IRL moment travel online: events you ran that became posts people actually saw, shared, and showed up because of.
* A real presence on or fluency with Twitter, especially the hard tech and defense tech corners of it.
* A track record of running a hosted format people ask to be invited to.
* A real Bay Area network in hard tech, defense tech, robotics, or autonomy.
* Equal comfort with vibe and funnel: has made things that were simply great, and has shipped work with attribution behind it, and refuses to choose between the two.
* Production instinct: comfortable directing video, photography, and editorial and getting it out the door fast.
* Operational exactness: contracts, deposits, shipping deadlines, badge scanners, vendor invoices.
* Comfort in the CRM and marketing automation stack, building your own invite lists and running your own campaigns.
* Willingness to travel: roughly one show a month in season, plus regular time in LA and periodic trips to DC.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience marketing in NDA\-constrained environments, where much of what customers do cannot be named on a banner.
* Experience opening a new market or city for a company previously concentrated in one place.
* Existing relationships with venue, production, and experiential vendors in San Francisco.
* Experience running partner and co\-marketing motions, including shared booths and co\-hosted events.

**Location:**
-------------


This role is based in our San Francisco office at 211 Sutter Street and is in person four days a week. Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (next to LAX); expect regular travel to LA, roughly one industry event per month in season, and periodic travel to Washington, DC. We come together as a company for a full week every three months.


Salary range: $125,000 \- $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

### **About Rootly**

  

  

At Rootly, we are on a mission to be the go\-to way companies respond when things go wrong, helping every organization be more reliable. We do this by building an industry\-leading incident management platform that allows companies around the world consistently and quickly resolve incidents. We are not simply transforming an industry, we are carving an entirely new \+$B segment ourselves and need incredible talent to achieve this ambitious goal together.  

  

Customers love Rootly. Some of the fastest growing companies around the world such as NVIDIA, Figma, Canva, Tripadvisor, Squarespace and more rely on Rootly to power their critical incident management process. They obsess over our delightful enterprise\-ready platform and unique partnership model.  

  

Investors love Rootly. We are backed by some of the most respected funds in the world from Y Combinator to operators like the CTO of Dropbox and GitHub. We'd be happy to disclose our entire funding and profitability picture live during the interview. As a culture we relentlessly put transparency first. We conduct monthly financial reviews as a team so everyone has a pulse on the health of the business and publish what we are building in our weekly changelog.  

  

### **About the Role**

  

  

You will be responsible for generating qualified leads and initiating the sales process. You will work closely with the sales and marketing teams to identify target markets, reach out to potential customers, and nurture relationships to drive revenue growth. Your primary focus will be on outbound prospecting, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings for the sales team.  

  

**Prospecting and Lead Generation:**  

  

* Conduct thorough market research to identify potential customers within target industries and segments.
* Utilize various sources, including online platforms, industry databases, and social media, to identify and engage with prospects.
* Cold call, email, and use other communication channels to initiate contact with potential customers.
* Qualify leads based on predefined criteria and gather relevant information to assess their potential as prospects.
  

  

**Relationship Building:**  

  

* Establish rapport and build strong relationships with key decision\-makers and influencers within target organizations.
* Understand the needs, pain points, and objectives of potential customers to tailor the sales approach accordingly.
* Effectively communicate the value proposition of our products or services to potential clients.
* Conduct engaging and informative product demonstrations or presentations when necessary.
  

  

**Sales Support and Collaboration:**  

  

* Collaborate closely with the sales team to ensure a seamless handoff of qualified leads.
* Provide detailed and accurate lead information, including prospect details, requirements, and communication history, to the sales team.
* Continuously update and maintain customer relationship management (CRM) software with accurate and up\-to\-date information.
  

  

### **What You'll Need:**

  

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in a similar business development or sales role, preferably within the technology industry.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and effectively engage with diverse audiences.
* Excellent phone etiquette and active listening skills.
* Self\-motivated and results\-oriented, with a drive to exceed targets and achieve sales goals.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
* Familiarity with CRM software and other sales enablement tools. I.E. Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha, etc

Opentrons Labworks, Inc. is a disruptive life science company leveraging its integrated lab platform to supercharge the pace of innovation in research and healthcare. Website \& Conversion Optimization:* Ensure digital traffic converts efficiently into pipeline.
* Drive CRO initiatives including landing page strategy, form optimization, personalization, and conversion path testing.

Contractor \& Agency Management:* Own all digital contractor and agency relationships end to end, serving as the primary point of contact for scope, deliverables, budget, and performance.
* Manage SOWs and budgets, setting clear performance expectations and evaluating output to recommend scope changes, renewals, or new vendors.

Experience:* 5–7 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, CRM management, or related roles, including experience setting strategy and reporting to senior stakeholders.

**About BlueMatrix:**
BlueMatrix is the market\-leading platform for content creation, distribution, and compliance in the investment research industry. We support many of the world’s top banks, asset managers, and independent research providers, enabling them to publish high\-quality research efficiently and securely. As we expand our reach into new markets and industries, we’re looking for a motivated and ambitious Business Development Representative to help fuel our growth.

**The Role:**
As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be on the front lines of our sales organization, responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential clients. You will play a critical role in creating pipeline for our Account Executives by proactively sourcing new business opportunities, responding to inbound interest, and booking high\-quality meetings. This is a foundational role with clear career progression into sales, marketing, or customer success.
### **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and research high\-potential target accounts and key decision\-makers across financial institutions, research firms, and asset management companies.
* Drive outbound prospecting efforts through a mix of cold calls, personalized email outreach, LinkedIn engagement, and social selling strategies.
* Proactively follow up on marketing\-generated leads from webinars, events, and digital campaigns to convert interest into qualified opportunities.
* Respond promptly and professionally to inbound leads and inquiries, ensuring a seamless prospect experience.
* Qualify leads using the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline) to assess fit and readiness for engagement.
* Collaborate closely with Account Executives to route and hand off qualified opportunities, ensuring smooth transitions through the sales funnel.


**Meeting Booking \& Sales Support**
* Secure and schedule discovery calls and demos for the sales team
* Maintain detailed records of activities, touchpoints, and conversations in the CRM (e.g., Salesforce or HubSpot)
* Collaborate with Account Executives and Marketing to refine messaging and optimize outreach strategies


**Performance Tracking \& Growth**
* Meet and exceed weekly/monthly KPIs including calls, emails, meetings booked, and opportunities created
* Continuously learn about BlueMatrix’s products, industry trends, and client challenges
* Participate in team trainings, sales meetings, and cross\-functional projects to grow your skills

### **Job Requirements:**

* 1–2 years of experience in a BDR, SDR, or sales\-related role (B2B SaaS or FinTech experience is a plus)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable with cold outreach and high\-volume prospecting
* Organized, self\-motivated, and eager to learn
* Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo)
* Knowledge of financial services, capital markets, or research workflows is a bonus

Base salary plus generous commission opportunities for meeting or exceeding targets.**WHAT WE DO**
BlueMatrix develops one\-of\-a\-kind web applications for the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research, and for internal knowledge management and digital communications. Our mission is to streamline the publishing process on a global scale.

**WHY WORK WITH US**
The BlueMatrix team is made up of ambitious and passionate people who have turned technology development and client service into an art. Many have dedicated the majority of their career to growing the BlueMatrix brand and helping shape the investment research marketplace.
With locations in New York City, Durham, London, Edinburgh, and Timisoara, Romania, we collaborate across the globe for a unique perspective on the impact of technology in our industry.

**You can also count on:**
o Competitive Compensation (based on experience)
o Health Care Plan
o Generous Vacation/Personal Days
o Generous Referral Program

**About POS360**



We are a rapidly growing technology company specializing in point\-of\-sale payment processing and delivery integrations for locally owned brick\-and\-mortar stores. Our mission is to accelerate the transition from traditional electronic cash registers to powerful new point of sale products. Our highly specialized systems address the specific pain points identified through over a decade of working with neighborhood stores, markets, and restaurants. With an unrivaled dedication to delivering superior tools that are easy to use and a technical team providing industry\-leading support, our systems open the door to the next level of success for our clients.

This role is essential to expanding our footprint within independent retail, particularly liquor and off premise accounts by building trusted relationships and delivering value‑focused solutions.

  



You will own your territory end\-to\-end, from prospecting and in‑store demos through installation, activation, and ongoing account growth. Working closely with company leadership and cross‑functional teams, you’ll play a key role in strengthening client relationships and accelerating POS360’s growth in the market.

**Product Demos \& Client Enablement**


* Conduct in‑store demonstrations of POS360 portfolio of products and solutions through various platforms and media
* Clearly articulate customer pain points and position POS360 as a revenue driving solution
* Train store owners, managers, and cashiers on POS systems, ancillary products, and services

  


**Account Ownership \& Relationship Management**


* Own client relationships from first conversation through installation, activation, and long\-term success

* Resolve customer issues by partnering with Client Services, Deployment, and Operations teams

  


**Sales Operations \& Market Intelligence**


* Negotiate pricing and terms; prepare agreements and close deals
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, call reports, territory plans, and performance reporting
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and delivery platform dynamics (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart)
* Recommend product, service, or policy improvements based on field insights

  


**Collaboration \& Leadership Engagement**


* Work closely with Marketing, Procurement, Client Services, and Deployment teams to ensure smooth execution
* Report weekly to leadership and participate in Monday team syncs
* Contribute to a high\-performance, collaborative sales culture

  


**Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of sales experience; liquor, beverage, or off premise retail sales experience highly preferred
* Demonstrated success in value based, relationship driven sales
* Experience calling directly on independent retail decision makers
* Familiarity with CRM tools and maintaining accurate activity records
* Proficient with office software and phone systems


**Preferred Education \& Skills**


* BA/BS degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Advertising, or a related field
* Bilingual: Fluent in English **and** Spanish or Arabic
* Interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills

  


**Benefits**


* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid time off
* Flexible working hours
* Free on\-site gym access

  


**Position is full\-time and remote and can be located Atlanta, GA area**  

**Compensation: $75,000 base \+ Commission OTE $195,000 no cap**

  

  

**POS360, Inc, Is A Drug Free Workplace**  

Please note that POS360 is a drug\-free workplace and all candidates are required to undergo a pre\-employment drug screening before being fully employed. This policy is in place to ensure the safety and health of all employees.

  


**POS360, Inc. Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Equal access to programs, services and employment is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

FlexTG \| Position Description**CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGER**


Modern Position Description

 **Position Title**

  

Client Relationship Manager

 **Department**

  

Sales / Client Account Management

 **FLSA Status**

  

Exempt

 **Travel**

  

As needed to support client and internal business needs

 **COMPANY OVERVIEW**


FlexTG provides managed print and workplace technology services with a national footprint. Our teams are focused on delivering a consistent client experience, strong operational execution, and practical solutions that help customers run their business more effectively.

**JOB SUMMARY**


The Client Relationship Manager, or CRM, is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients after implementation. The CRM is responsible for customer satisfaction, retention, account growth, day\-to\-day account activity, issue resolution, internal coordination, and overall account health.


This role combines relationship management, operational follow\-through, account planning, business review preparation, data analysis, and cross\-functional leadership. The CRM works closely with Sales, Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Billing, Contracts, Project Management, and Leadership to make sure client needs are understood, documented, prioritized, and driven to resolution.

**Role Focus**


A successful CRM keeps the client experience organized, responsive, and professional while protecting revenue, identifying opportunities, and ensuring internal teams have clear direction on account priorities. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Relationship and Account Ownership**

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned client accounts.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with executive sponsors, operational stakeholders, site contacts, and end\-user communities.
* Understand each client’s business objectives, contract scope, service expectations, billing requirements, technology goals, and operational priorities.
* Own customer satisfaction, retention, growth, profitability, and overall account health for the assigned client portfolio.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all aspects of the contractual relationship with the customer.

**Operational Support and Issue Resolution**

* Support customers’ day\-to\-day needs with clear communication, urgency, and ownership.
* Coordinate internal resources to fulfill service level agreements, resolve client issues, and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Provide the interface between customers, end users, technical support, service, operations, and other internal resources.
* Investigate customer complaints or concerns, develop practical solutions, and manage open items through completion.
* Escalate high\-risk service, supply, billing, contract, or operational issues appropriately while maintaining client communication.

**Business Reviews and Account Planning**

* Prepare for and lead regular client business reviews, executive partnership reviews, account planning sessions, and strategic check\-ins.
* Use reporting, metrics, and account data to bring value to the client and align recommendations with short\-term and long\-term technology goals.
* Identify risks, opportunities, usage trends, service patterns, supply activity, billing concerns, and areas for improvement.
* Develop clear action plans for renewals, expansions, fleet changes, program improvements, and additional phases of business.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Sales, Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Billing, Contracts, Project Management, and Leadership to ensure a coordinated approach to customer needs.
* Support onboarding for new customers and partner with implementation teams on deployment, inventory collection, device management, consumables management, and service readiness.
* Communicate client feedback, operational gaps, and process improvement opportunities to the appropriate internal teams.
* Recommend and help implement operational practices that improve productivity, efficiency, cost control, service quality, and customer outcomes.

**Documentation, Reporting, and Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate account documentation, meeting notes, action items, contact records, contract details, fleet information, and follow\-up commitments.
* Use Microsoft 365, CRM systems, reporting platforms, and internal business systems to manage account information and prepare client\-facing materials.
* Document current\-state and future\-state business processes when needed to support client planning, program changes, and internal alignment.
* Develop continual process improvements that strengthen the customer experience and improve internal execution.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

* Strong client relationship management skills with the ability to build trust and credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with client executives and operational contacts.
* Strong customer focus, sound judgment, and a sense of urgency in all work.
* High level of organization, follow\-through, and ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, deadlines, and open issues at the same time.
* Strong analytical and reasoning abilities with the ability to review data, identify trends, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience managing projects with cross\-functional or multi\-disciplined team members.
* Ability to develop and strengthen customer relationships while balancing client needs, contractual requirements, and business outcomes.
* Comfortable working independently, remotely, and across multiple internal departments.
* Professional presence, mature judgment, flexibility, and well\-developed interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Experience with CRM, ERP, service management, reporting, or managed print platforms preferred.

**ED

**OFFICE OF THE CHIEF JUDGE**  

**CIRCUIT COURT OF COOK COUNTY, ILLINOIS**  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**POSITION TITLE**: Problem\-Solving Court Project Coordinator  

**BUSINESS UNIT**: Problem\-Solving Courts (PSC)  

**POSITION CLASSIFICATION**: Exempt  

**PAY GRADE**: Grade 19  

**Salary:** $80,355 **Location:** Various  

**Hours:** 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. or as assigned  

The Office of the Chief Judge is seeking a project coordinator to provide administrative and operational support to the judges and team members in the Problem\-Solving Courts (Drug Courts, Veterans Courts, and Mental Health Courts) currently operating in the Circuit Court of Cook County. This is a full\-time, limited duration position fully devoted to support the administration and management of the Cook County Adult Redeploy Illinois (ARI) grant funded projects.  

  

**OVERVIEW**  

The Project Coordinator’s responsibilities include troubleshooting and monitoring court operations and achievement of project goals and objectives, assisting the Director of Problem\-Solving with management of daily operations, assisting the team with data collection for the project, grant management, quarterly programmatic and financial reporting, and coordination of interagency and community partnerships to expand substance use disorder (SUD) and behavioral health treatment services.  

  

**ESSENTIAL** **FUNCTIONS**  

The essential functions of the Project Coordinator include the following:* Work with the Director of Problem\-Solving Courts and PSC administration team to implement program activities and coordinate the collection of program data to meet PSC reporting requirements;
* Work collaboratively with a PSC administration team as well as third\-party vendors and partner agencies to meet program and service objectives of the PSC;
* Coordination and management of interagency and community partnerships, including treatment providers and clinical case management providers;
* Attend scheduled court staffings and status calls;
* Monitor and maintain an accurate database of program participants from referral to termination;
* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual ARI performance reports for approval by the program agency prior to dissemination to interested parties or submission to grant funding agencies;
* Work with the Director of Problem\-Solving Courts in the coordination of ongoing education and training for PSC team members to ensure compliance program standards;
* Meet productivity standards as established by the Director of Problem\-Solving.

**Organization Overview**
Nourishing Hope is a dynamic Chicago nonprofit agency. Nourishing Hope has evolved to become more than solely a hunger relief organization. We provide food, social services such as job and housing assistance, and free mental wellness counseling with a growing team of licensed therapists. Founded in 1970, we strive to serve the needs of the whole person — with respect and dignity, always.  

Nourishing Hope offers our neighbors nutritious food using a choice\-based distribution model and access to life\-changing social services including:* Monthly food distribution and additional produce pickup through five different food access programs.
* Home delivery services for older adults, homebound neighbors and neighbors living with disabilities.
* Social services including case management, mental health counseling, job search support, domestic violence intervention, referrals and public benefits assistance (SNAP, healthcare, government forms) for anyone in need.

  

Nourishing Hope serves tens of thousands of people each year, providing more than 4 million meals through our programs, in addition to partnerships with other community organizations. This year, more than 7,000 low\-income neighbors will also receive case management and social services. **Position Summary**
The Home Delivery Program Coordinator primarily supports the effective delivery of Nourishing Hope’s food distribution programming, including the In\-Person Markets, Home Delivery, and Online Market program models, as appropriate. This role supports all aspects of daily food distribution programming for Home Delivery, including neighbor and volunteer engagement, operations and logistics, data tracking and reporting, and food safety and sanitation. This role acts as a liaison to all neighbors, volunteers, staff, and other stakeholders to ensure a dignified and respectful experience. **Schedule and Locations**
