new_jobs.description:
**ADP is hiring a Sales Operations Manager – Governance Specialist** as part of the Sales Enablement team within Worldwide Commercial Operations. Defines AI content guardrails, risk, controls, compliance, workflows, and escalation paths.


\*\*This is a hybrid position, 3 days per week in the office and 2 days per week from home. Qualified candidates must live within commutable distance to one of our commercial offices and be willing to work on a hybrid schedule.\*\*


**Role Purpose:**


* Ensures all AI\-generated outputs meet legal, compliance, and brand standards while maintaining safe and ethical AI practices.
* Defines governance frameworks, risk controls, and escalation paths for AI\-generated content.
* Builds trust and scalability by embedding compliance into AI workflows.

**Key Focus Areas:**


* AI content compliance and risk management
* Governance frameworks and approval workflows
* Bias, hallucination, and data privacy risk mitigation
* Policy definition and enforcement

**Core Deliverables:**


* Governance policies and compliance frameworks for AI outputs
* Approval and escalation workflows for sensitive content
* Risk audit findings and mitigation recommendations
* Documentation for traceability and version control

**Ways of Working:**


* Partners with legal and compliance teams to define standards
* Conducts audits and monitors for risk signals in AI outputs
* Implements approval layers and human\-in\-the\-loop processes
* Educates stakeholders on governance requirements and best practices

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships:**


* Legal, compliance, and security teams for regulatory alignment
* Agent Enablement and Orchestration teams for workflow integration
* Prompt Engineer to embed guardrails into prompts
* Sales and enablement teams for adoption and awareness

**Success Metrics:**


* Compliance adherence and reduction in risk incidents
* Audit pass rates and governance coverage
* Trust in AI\-generated outputs across stakeholders
* Effectiveness of escalation and approval processes

**Role Interdependencies:**


* AI Messaging Specialist identifies quality and risk signals
* Prompt Engineer embeds guardrails into prompts
* Agent Enablement and Orchestrator implement governance in workflows
* Governance Specialist owns policy, compliance, and risk management

**Qualifications:**


* Experience in compliance, risk management, legal operations, privacy, security governance, content governance, or regulated communications
* Strong understanding of AI risks such as hallucination, bias, privacy exposure, unsupported claims, data leakage, and inaccurate personalization
* Ability to design clear approval tiers and escalation paths
* Experience writing policies, standards, procedures, or governance documentation
* Strong collaboration skills with Legal, Compliance, Security, Product, Enablement, and Sales
* Ability to balance risk reduction with business usability
* Excellent communication and training skills

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative (National Retail)
new_jobs.description:
Build a Better Career as an Outside Sales Representative – National Retail with BlueLinx!
  
  

At BlueLinx, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to ensuring our team members can build job security, enhance their skills, and make meaningful contributions. We deliver the building blocks to better lives.
  
Join us and be part of a company that values its people and strives to make a positive impact in the industry.
  
  

Summary
  
BlueLinx is seeking a driven Outside Sales Representative – National Retail to manage existing national retail relationships while aggressively growing new revenue within the region. This role requires a true hunter mentality motivated by uncovering new opportunities, expanding partnerships, and driving profitable growth.
  
  

The ideal candidate is confident calling on national retailers, engaging previous customers, developing new revenue streams, and strengthening established accounts. Relationship building is critical to success in this role. This position offers a competitive base salary plus commission structure.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Identify new sales opportunities with both new and existing national retail customers, with a focus on program business.
* Maximize sales effectiveness by prioritizing time and effort on the largest and most profitable opportunities, including segmentation of account lists.
* Improve overall profitability, product penetration, and product mix across assigned accounts.
* Qualify sales opportunities through market and customer research and collaboration with insider sales partners.
* Develop sales solutions and competitive pricing strategies; articulate value propositions to customers.
* Present and propose sales solutions to customers and adjust strategies as needed based on customer feedback and market conditions.
* Close sales opportunities by securing purchase orders and ensuring all order fulfillment procedures are executed accurately.
* Provide outstanding post sale service and support to ensure long term customer satisfaction and repeat business.


What We’re Looking For
  
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent industry experience strongly preferred.
* 0–2 years of experience in a sales role with responsibility for growing accounts and generating new business.
* Ability to manage an existing book of business while expanding partnerships.
* Building materials or related industry experience is a plus.
* Strong market knowledge, product familiarity, and consultative selling skills.
* Demonstrated “hunter” mentality with a strong drive for results.
* Excellent planning, organization, communication, problem solving, and decision making skills.
* Working knowledge of account management, customer service, product pricing, sales support, warehousing, distribution, and transportation.
* Self motivated, disciplined, and performance driven.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and relevant sales systems and technology.
* Strong telephone and communication skills with the ability to identify needs, evaluate solutions, and recommend action.


Why BlueLinx?
  
* 60,000 \- 65,000 plus incentive/commission plan
* Comprehensive benefits package including:
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Life insurance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Company Ownership
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) starting day one and 8 company holidays
* Opportunity to grow your career with a leading national building products distributor


Our Values
  
With every decision and action, we put people first, keep the future in mind, and work as a team toward shared progress:
  
Customer Centric • Respect • Collaboration • Integrity • Grit
  
  

About BlueLinx
  
**BlueLinx (NYSE:** BXC) is a leading wholesale distributor of building and industrial products in the United States. With over 70,000 branded and private label SKUs, we service customers nationwide through an extensive distribution network. Our more than 2,000 associates are critical to our success, and we pride ourselves on a culture rooted in teamwork, integrity, safety, and customer service.
  
  

Compensation Disclosure
  
The salary range provided is a good faith estimate based on position requirements and market data. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and other job related considerations. BlueLinx also offers a comprehensive benefits package starting the first day of the month.
  
  

To report any issues with this job posting, please contact Talent@BlueLinxCo.com

new_jobs.title: Project Manager Digital Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**Project Manager — Marcel Digital**

*(Hybrid \| Chicagoland candidates only)*


As a Project Manager at Marcel Digital, you’ll support the successful delivery of software development and digital services projects while growing into full, independent ownership over time. You’ve already built a foundation — one to three years in digital marketing, agency work, or digital project delivery — and you’re ready to put it to work.


You’ll work closely with senior project managers, subject matter experts, and cross\-functional teams to coordinate timelines, track progress, and maintain clear communication across stakeholders. You’ll start with meaningful project responsibility from day one, and take on increasing ownership of mid\-size projects and client relationships as your confidence and capabilities grow.

**The expected salary range for this position is $60k \- $80k**

**Role Description**

**Project Management \& Support**


Manage and support the execution of software development and digital services projects — helping manage budget, scope and timelines, tracking deliverables, and ensuring tasks move forward. You’ll play a key role in keeping projects organized and on track.

**Client Communication**


Communicate with clients both individually and alongside senior team members. You’ll document discussions, follow up on action items, and steadily take the lead on more client interactions.

**Planning \& Task Management**


Translate project requirements into actionable tasks. You’ll maintain project plans, support the creation of monthly tasks, keep tools up to date, and ensure team members have clarity on next steps. You’re more than just a traffic cop, you understand the requests to drive work forward and actively manage them through completion and delivery.

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Overview:
**If** **You’re** **Great at Sales, We’ve Got the Career for You**


Are you a natural at connecting with people and closing deals? At Orkin, we’ll turn your drive and people skills into a successful, long\-term sales career – with **uncapped earning potential** and the backing of the most recognized name in pest control.


As an Orkin Sales Inspector, you’ll offer homeowners genuine peace of mind by providing trusted protection backed by over 120 years of expertise, the Orkin Guarantee, and a brand customers already trust. You’ll also enjoy award\-winning training, career development, and the satisfaction of helping families protect their most valuable investment, their home.

**Why Orkin?**


At Orkin, we do more than eliminate pests – we protect health, homes, and peace of mind by providing many different services, including:

* Attic cleanouts for wildlife issues
* Crawl space remediation
* Termite treatments and complete pest control solutions
* Full home exclusions using metal and professional\-grade sealants

  

We are driven by a shared mission and grounded in values that define everything we do:

* Safety
* Professionalism
* Empathy
* Integrity
* Innovation

  

With a reputation built over more than a century and a team\-first culture, you’ll feel supported from day one – with the freedom and tools to succeed.


Responsibilities: **What** **You’ll** **Be Doing**

* Conducting full\-home inspections (from attic to crawl space)
* Build trust by explaining your findings clearly and recommending the best treatment options.
* Close sales by showcasing the value, protection, and long\-term benefits of Orkin’s services
* Manage appointments, follow\-ups, and documentation using a company\-provided iPad.
* Work independently, prioritize your schedule, and maximize leads and self\-generated opportunities.
* Represent Orkin with professionalism, empathy, and integrity every step of the way.

 **What’s In It for You?**

* **Top Earning Potential: Average First Year Earnings between $70,000 and $100,000 (base \+ commission)**
* **Uncapped Commission:** The more you sell, the more you earn
* **Company Vehicle:** Gas card included
* **Paid Training:** No pest control experience required – we’ll teach you everything.
* **Benefits that Go Beyond:**
* Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan, tuition reimbursement, and scholarship opportunities
* **Recognition \& Awards:** Top performers can earn exclusive annual incentive trips and advancement opportunities


Qualifications:
**You’d** **Be a Great Fit If You:**

* Love meeting new people and helping solve real problems
* Are confident, competitive, and goal\-driven
* Can work independently and stay organized
* Don’t mind climbing, crawling, or working in various weather conditions.

 **Minimum** **Requirements**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Use a ladder safely within the manufacturer’s weight capacity.
* Lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, rooftops, etc.
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE), which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator.

 **Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer**

**You may not know our name, but you know our products. What we make is part the places where we live, work and play – all day, everyday.**


Zekelman is a family of companies — 100% domestic manufacturers — with a legacy dating back to 1877\. We’re proud to be the largest independent steel pipe and tube manufacturer in North America and the leading innovator in multi\-family housing development.

**We believe in what we build and what we build, builds the world around us. Hospitals, hotels, schools, bridges, airports and more.**

**Come build a career you believe in.**


The Outside Sales Representative for Atlas Tube is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with customers, which will allow them to focus on generating new and existing business, developing new accounts while growing current accounts. These actions will help achieve sales goals by providing technical expertise, exceptional customer service and the high\-quality Atlas Tube HSS products. The Outside Sales Representative will report to the Regional Manager and work with sales management in setting goals, learning about the HSS market and working with all departments to achieve financial and tonnage goals. **This position covers South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia****.**

**Job Requirements**

* Develop and maintain customer relationships through travel and regular communication.
* Prospect for new customers and generate qualified sales leads.
* Prepare daily, job, CRU, and project quotes.
* Follow up on orders and coordinate with the Inside Sales Representative team through completion.
* Provide customer service, technical support, and assistance with customer claims.
* Conduct customer outcalls and telephone sales activities.
* Monitor and communicate customer, competitor, and market intelligence.
* Complete monthly territory reviews and maintain the pricing matrix.
* Participate in goal setting and performance reviews.
* Visit Atlas locations as part of the educational process.
* Manage time effectively and perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, college diploma, or equivalent experience.
* Seven or more years of related business or sales experience.
* Strong customer relationship\-building and communication skills.
* Ability to prospect for new business and grow existing accounts.
* Strong quoting, follow\-up, organization, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to provide technical support and resolve customer concerns.
* **Must be based within the assigned territory and able to travel throughout the region as needed.**
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with sales management, Inside Sales Representatives, and other departments.


Compensation for this role is $90,000 \- $125,000 plus bonus.


Zekelman Industries offers competitive compensation and excellent benefits, including low\-cost, high\-quality medical and dental benefits. In addition, we have an amazing tuition assistance program, a bonus plan, a 401(k) plan with a generous company match, immediate vesting, and much more.
